taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* All bias currents are mirrored from the 20 uA reference. Standard-Vt PMOS is
* used where output resistance matters; LVT devices where headroom matters.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------------- bias from the 20 uA reference ----------------
XMR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
XMNB pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
XMNC vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMNA vbabp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
XMP0 pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=20
XMPC vbnc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
XMPA vbabn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=20
XMPS vsw pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=10
* cascode gate references
RPC vdd pc1 40k
XPCD vbpc vbpc pc1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
RNC vbnc nc1 50k
XNCD nc1 nc1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* class-AB translinear references: VSG(XPO)+VSG(XP8) = VSG(XPD1)+VSG(XPD2) and
* VGS(XNO)+VGS(XN8) = VGS(XND1)+VGS(XND2) set the output quiescent current
XPD1 x1 x1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=17 nf=3
XPD2 vbabp vbabp x1 x1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=117 nf=26
XND2 vbabn vbabn y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XND1 y1 y1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* current-switch reference: one NMOS VGS plus 0.2 V above vss
RSW vsw sw1 40k
XSWD sw1 sw1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=36 nf=6
* ---------------- complementary input stage ----------------
* The NMOS pair owns the tail current for mid/high common mode. As the common
* mode falls below vsw, XSW steers that current through XPSD/XPT (1:1.35) into
* the PMOS pair, so only one pair is active and gm stays nearly constant.
XMNT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
XN1 a1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=72 nf=12
XN2 a2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=72 nf=12
XSW nsw vsw ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=144 nf=24
XPSD nsw nsw vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=20
XPT ptail nsw vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=135 nf=27
XP1 b1 vinn ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=136 nf=34
XP2 b2 vinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=136 nf=34
* ---------------- folded-cascode summing circuit ----------------
XMP3 a1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=60
XMP4 a2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=60
XP5 c1 vbpc a1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XP6 gp vbpc a2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XN5 d1 vbnc b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XN6 gn vbnc b2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XN3 b1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=16
XN4 b2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=16
* floating current source (left) and floating class-AB control (right)
XP7 d1 vbabp c1 c1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=117 nf=26
XN7 c1 vbabn d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XP8 gn vbabp gp gp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=117 nf=26
XN8 gp vbabn gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
* ---------------- class-AB output stage ----------------
XPO vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=20
XNO vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
* series-RC Miller compensation
RZP vout zp 1k
CCP zp gp 2.8p
RZN vout zn 1k
CCN zn gn 2.8p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8 V core MOS only; ideal R/C for degeneration, level shifts and compensation.
* Signal path: LVT NMOS + LVT PMOS input pairs (P tail steered to the N pair by a current
* switch above ~0.63 V), folded-cascode current-summing stage with a floating current
* source, Monticelli-type class-AB control, common-source rail-to-rail output and
* series-RC Miller compensation to both output gates. Bias: PTAT beta multiplier
* (constant-gm) plus constant currents mirrored from the 20 uA iref input.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ===== bias generation =====
* 20 uA reference sink and constant-current PMOS unit (5 uA)
XMR0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40
XMRC1 pbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10
XMRC2 pbc pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
* PTAT constant-gm beta multiplier with start-up
XMB1 nb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25
XMB2 pb1 nb1 rsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200
RB rsb vss 16000
XMB3 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
XMB4 nb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
XMS1 stc nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40
XMS2 stc vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=10 w=0.42
XMS3 pb1 stc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1
* input current-switch threshold
XMVS vsw pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
RVS vsw vss 126000
* ===== complementary input stage =====
XMPT1 tp pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=125
XMPT2 tp pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100
XMP1 fbl vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=300
XMP2 fbr vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=300
* current switch: steers the P-pair tail to the N pair at high common mode
XMSW nsw vsw tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=400
XMSWD nsw nsw vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40
XMNT tn nsw vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40
RSN1 sn1 tn 1050
RSN2 sn2 tn 1050
XMN1 ftl vinn sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=400
XMN2 ftr vinp sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=400
* ===== folded-cascode current-summing stage =====
* top: degenerated PMOS sources biased by a one-unit replica
XMTN1 pbt nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=11.3636
XMTN2 pbt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5.45455
XMTR pbt pbt rtr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=40
RTR vdd rtr 12000
RT1 vdd st1 1090.91
RT2 vdd st2 1090.91
XMT1 ftl pbt st1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=440
XMT2 ftr pbt st2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=440
XMC1 ntl vbpc ftl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
XMC2 nx vbpc ftr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100
* bottom: degenerated cascoded NMOS mirror driven from the left branch
XMC3 nbl vbnc fbl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200
XMC4 ny vbnc fbr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200
XMM1 fbl nbl sm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100
XMM2 fbr nbl sm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100
RM1 sm1 vss 1000
RM2 sm2 vss 1000
* cascode gate bias: replica diodes lifted by resistor drops
XMXP vbnc pbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
XMXN1 vbnc vbnc xb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
RXN xb1 vss 50000
XMXN vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10
XMXP1 vbpc vbpc xb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20
RXP vdd xb2 60000
* ===== floating current source (left) and class-AB control (right) =====
XMF1 nbl vabp ntl ntl sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=300
XMF2 ntl vabn nbl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30
XMF3 ny vabp nx nx sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=300
XMF4 nx vabn ny vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30
* translinear bias stacks (PTAT)
XMAP vabn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=25
XMA5 vabn vabn nab vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10
XMA6 nab nab vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5
XMA1 nap nap vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5
XMA2 vabp vabp nap nap sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100
XMAN vabp nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25
* ===== class-AB common-source output stage =====
XMOP vout nx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100
XMON vout ny vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=75
* ===== series-RC Miller compensation =====
RZ1 vout cz1 1000
CC1 cz1 nx 6.5e-12
RZ2 vout cz2 1000
CC2 cz2 ny 6.5e-12
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=12
XBP pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=12
XPB pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=120 nf=24

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* - complementary LVT NMOS/PMOS input pairs; a replica-referenced current switch
*   hands the tail current from the PMOS pair to the NMOS pair (constant gm)
* - folded-cascode current-summing stage biased by a floating current source
* - floating class-AB control driving a rail-to-rail common-source output stage
* - series-RC Miller compensation from the output to both output-device gates
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------------- bias (20uA reference) ----------------
XB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2
XB1N pref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2
XB1P pref pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=192 nf=19
* current-switch reference: 7.5uA into an NMOS input-pair replica on a resistor
XR1 vref pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=72 nf=7
XRN vref vref vrs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=54 nf=5
RREF vrs vss 1.87e+04
* bottom cascode bias (10uA replica diode on a resistor)
XNC1 ncas pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=96 nf=10
XNC2 ncas ncas ncr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
RNC ncr vss 2e+04
* top cascode bias (10uA replica diode on a resistor)
XPC1 pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XPC2 pcas pcas pcr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6
RPC vdd pcr 1.8e+04
* class-AB bias stacks (10uA each): output-device replica + control-device replica
XS1 vbn pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=96 nf=10
XD1 vbn vbn dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XD2 dn dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=24 nf=2
XS2 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XD4 vbp vbp dp dp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XD3 dp dp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=3
* ---------------- input stage ----------------
* PMOS pair with 40uA tail; XSW diverts the tail to the NMOS pair at high VCM
XPT sp pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=384 nf=38
XPA y1 vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=160 nf=16
XPB y2 vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=160 nf=16
XSW swd vref sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=320 nf=32
XSM1 swd swd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XSM2 sn swd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XNA x2 vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=72 nf=6
XNB x1 vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=72 nf=6
* switch-current compensation keeps the summing-branch current constant
XSM3 cpd swd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XCP0 cpd cpd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=400 nf=40
XCP1 x1 cpd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=20
XCP2 x2 cpd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=200 nf=20
* ---------------- folded-cascode summing circuit ----------------
* 40uA top sources, cascoded top and bottom, cascoded bottom mirror
XT1 x1 pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=384 nf=38
XT2 x2 pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=384 nf=38
XTC1 a1 pcas x1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=24
XTC2 a2 pcas x2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=24
XM1 y1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=120 nf=12
XM2 y2 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=120 nf=12
XMC1 b1 ncas y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XMC2 b2 ncas y2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
* floating current source (left branch)
XFP b1 vbp a1 a1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XFN a1 vbn b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
* floating class-AB control (right branch)
XAP b2 vbp a2 a2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XAN a2 vbn b2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
* ---------------- class-AB output stage ----------------
XOP vout a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=320 nf=32
XON vout b2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=240 nf=24
* series-RC Miller compensation
RZ1 vout cz1 1600
CC1 cz1 a2 5.5e-12
RZ2 vout cz2 1600
CC2 cz2 b2 5.5e-12
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* The two folded input paths drive complementary common-source output gates.
* Series RC networks compensate each path independently near the supply rails.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* 20 uA reference and complementary bias distribution.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XMPREF pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=1
XMNPB pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1

* Cascode bias branches, nominally 10 uA.
XMPCB pcas pcas pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XMPCBT pmid pmid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XMNPCB pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XMPNCB ncas pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
RNCAS ncas nmid 20k
XMNNCBT nmid nmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1

* NMOS differential input and its PMOS folded cascode.
XMNTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=1
XMNI1 nn vinn ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=2
XMNI2 np vinp ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=2
RNS1 ns1 ntail 2k
RNS2 ns2 ntail 2k
XMPBN1 nn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=30 nf=1
XMPBN2 np pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=30 nf=1
XMPFN1 fn pcas nn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XMPFN2 fp pcas np vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1

* Low current mirror sums the NMOS-input differential folded currents.
XMNLM1 fn fn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=6.25 nf=1
XMNLM2 fp fn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=6.25 nf=1

* PMOS differential input and its NMOS folded cascode.
XMPTAIL ptail pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=1
XMPI1 pn vinn ps1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=2
XMPI2 pp vinp ps2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=2
RPS1 ps1 ptail 2k
RPS2 ps2 ptail 2k
XMNBP1 pn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=15 nf=1
XMNBP2 pp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=15 nf=1
XMNFP1 hn ncas pn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XMNFP2 hp ncas pp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1

* High current mirror sums the PMOS-input differential folded currents.
XMPHM1 hn hn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=4
XMPHM2 hp hn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=4

* Complementary Class-AB output pair; separate gates give push-pull drive.
XMNOUT vout fp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=2
XMPOUT vout hp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=640 nf=4

* Restore the unused output-gate bias at either input-common-mode rail.
XMNINV nlow vinp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=2
XMPINV nlow vinp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMNCORE ncore nlow vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMPCORE ncore nlow vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
RFNBIAS fn frst 50k
RCASBIAS ncas frc 950k
XMNRBIAS frc nlow frst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMNLORST fp nlow frst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=4
XMNHIRST hp vinp hn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.9 nf=1

* Split-path series-RC Miller compensation.
XMNCOMP ncn ncore fp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
RCN ncn cn 2k
CCN cn vout 5.4p
RCP hp cp 2k
CCP cp vout 5.5p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ============================================================================
* 1. Bias Generation (20 uA injected into iref from vdd)
* ============================================================================
* Master NMOS bias diode (20 uA, with 2k source degeneration for matching/noise)
XMB_N0 iref iref nb_s0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24.0 nf=6
RB_N0 nb_s0 vss 2k

* Mirror to generate master PMOS bias (20 uA, referenced to vdd with 2k degen)
XMB_N1 nbias_p iref nb_s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24.0 nf=6
RB_N1 nb_s1 vss 2k
XMB_P0 nbias_p nbias_p pb_s0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48.0 nf=12
RB_P0 vdd pb_s0 2k

* High-swing NMOS cascode bias (vb_ncas, 10 uA): sets V(fold_n) ~ 0.24 V
XMB_P1 vb_ncas nbias_p pb_s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24.0 nf=6
RB_P1 vdd pb_s1 4k
XMB_NCAS vb_ncas vb_ncas nb_cas_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4
RB_NCAS nb_cas_s vss 24k

* High-swing PMOS cascode bias (vb_pcas, 10 uA): sets V(fold_p) ~ VDD - 0.23 V
XMB_N2 vb_pcas iref nb_s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12.0 nf=3
RB_N2 nb_s2 vss 4k
XMB_PCAS vb_pcas vb_pcas pb_cas_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=40.0 nf=8
RB_PCAS vdd pb_cas_s 23k

* Input current-switch threshold bias (vb_sw, 10 uA -> 54k resistor = 0.54 V PVT-invariant)
XMB_P_SW vb_sw nbias_p pb_s_sw vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24.0 nf=6
RB_P_SW vdd pb_s_sw 4k
RB_NSW vb_sw vss 54k

* Class-AB NMOS control gate bias (n_abp1, 5 uA):
* XMB_N_AB2 replicates XMN_OUT (1:12 ratio); XMB_N_AB1 replicates XMN_AB (1:4 ratio)
XMB_P_AB1 n_abp1 nbias_p pb_ab1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12.0 nf=3
RB_P_AB1 vdd pb_ab1 8k
XMB_N_AB1 n_abp1 n_abp1 n_abp2 n_abp2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=12.0 nf=2
XMB_N_AB2 n_abp2 n_abp2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.80 w=7.0 nf=1

* Class-AB PMOS control gate bias (n_abn1, 2.5 uA):
* Uses low-VSG l=0.18/0.15 diodes so n_abn1 stays >0.10V even at 1.62V, -40C SS
XMB_N_AB3 n_abn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3.0 w=4.0 nf=1
XMB_P_AB3 n_abn1 n_abn1 n_abn2 n_abn2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36.0 nf=6
XMB_P_AB4 n_abn2 n_abn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=10.0 nf=2

* ============================================================================
* 2. Complementary Input Stage with Constant-Gm Steering & Folding Compensation
* ============================================================================
* PMOS tail current source (40 uA)
XMP_TAIL tail_p nbias_p pb_tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=96.0 nf=16
RB_TAIL_P vdd pb_tail 1k

* PMOS differential input pair (l=0.18 for low VSG & 550 ohm degen for constant Gm)
RSP1 tail_p sp_inp 550
RSP2 tail_p sp_inn 550
XMP_INP fold_n2 vinp sp_inp tail_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=160.0 nf=20
XMP_INN fold_n1 vinn sp_inn tail_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=160.0 nf=20

* PMOS current switch (matched l=0.18, steers tail_p when VCM > 0.54V)
RSP_SW tail_p sp_sw 275
XMP_SW n_sw_p vb_sw sp_sw tail_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=240.0 nf=24

* Small bleed current (2 uA) to keep switch mirror warm for fast step recovery
XMP_BLEED n_sw_p nbias_p pb_bleed vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4.8 nf=1
RB_BLEED vdd pb_bleed 20k

* NMOS switch mirror: drives NMOS input tail_n and folding-node compensation
XMN_SW0 n_sw_p n_sw_p sn_sw0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48.0 nf=8
RSN_SW0 sn_sw0 vss 2k
XMN_SW1 tail_n n_sw_p sn_sw1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=36.0 nf=6
RSN_SW1 sn_sw1 vss 2.667k

* NMOS differential input pair (large gate area for low offset/1/f noise, 600 ohm degen)
RSN1 tail_n sn_inp 600
RSN2 tail_n sn_inn 600
XMN_INP fold_p2 vinp sn_inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=96.0 nf=16
XMN_INN fold_p1 vinn sn_inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=96.0 nf=16

* Folding-node common-mode current cancellation mirror:
* Cancels DC current shift at fold_p1/2 and fold_n1/2 when XMP_SW steers current
XMN_SW_C n_comp_p n_sw_p sn_swc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24.0 nf=4
RSN_SWC sn_swc vss 4k
XMP_COMP0 n_comp_p n_comp_p pb_comp0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48.0 nf=8
RB_COMP0 vdd pb_comp0 2k

* Inject 0.5*I(tail_n) into fold_p1 and fold_p2 (with 2.667k degen for low noise/offset)
XMP_COMP_P1 fold_p1 n_comp_p pb_cp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=36.0 nf=6
RB_CP1 vdd pb_cp1 2.667k
XMP_COMP_P2 fold_p2 n_comp_p pb_cp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=36.0 nf=6
RB_CP2 vdd pb_cp2 2.667k

* Inject 0.5*I(XMP_SW) into fold_n1 and fold_n2 (with 2k degen for low noise/offset)
XMP_COMP_N1 fold_n1 n_comp_p pb_cn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48.0 nf=8
RB_CN1 vdd pb_cn1 2k
XMP_COMP_N2 fold_n2 n_comp_p pb_cn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=48.0 nf=8
RB_CN2 vdd pb_cn2 2k

* ============================================================================
* 3. Folded-Cascode Current-Summing Stage & Floating Class-AB Control
* ============================================================================
* Top PMOS current sources (40 uA each, 2k degenerated for low noise, low offset & high Rout)
XMP_TOP1 fold_p1 nbias_p pb_top1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=96.0 nf=16
RB_TOP1 vdd pb_top1 2k
XMP_TOP2 fold_p2 nbias_p pb_top2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=96.0 nf=16
RB_TOP2 vdd pb_top2 2k

* PMOS cascodes (40 uA quiescent, l=0.8 for high gm*ro)
XMP_CAS1 cas_p1 vb_pcas fold_p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=160.0 nf=16
XMP_CAS2 vgp    vb_pcas fold_p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=160.0 nf=16

* Bottom NMOS current mirror (60 uA each, 1.5k degenerated for low noise, low offset & high Rout)
XMN_BOT1 fold_n1 cas_n1 nb_bot1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=96.0 nf=16
RB_BOT1 nb_bot1 vss 1.5k
XMN_BOT2 fold_n2 cas_n1 nb_bot2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=96.0 nf=16
RB_BOT2 nb_bot2 vss 1.5k

* NMOS cascodes (40 uA quiescent, l=1.0 for high gm*ro)
XMN_CAS1 cas_n1 vb_ncas fold_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=64.0 nf=8
XMN_CAS2 vgn    vb_ncas fold_n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=64.0 nf=8

* Left-side replica level-shifter: holds V(cas_p1) == V(vgp) without fighting V(cas_n1)
XMP_AB_REP cas_n1 n_abn1 cas_p1 cas_p1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=576.0 nf=48

* Right-side floating Class-AB control mesh between vgp and vgn (20 uA each)
XMN_AB vgp n_abp1 vgn vgn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48.0 nf=8
XMP_AB vgn n_abn1 vgp vgp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=288.0 nf=24

* ============================================================================
* 4. Class-AB Output Stage & Series-RC Miller Compensation
* ============================================================================
XMP_OUT vout vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.24 w=216.0 nf=36
XMN_OUT vout vgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.80 w=84.0 nf=12

* Series-RC Miller compensation
R_CP vout n_cp 3.8k
C_CP n_cp vgp 2.5p

R_CN vout n_cn 3.8k
C_CN n_cn vgn 2.5p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* =========================================================================
* 1. Reference Current Receiver & PTAT-Compensated Master Bias (IREF = 20 uA)
* =========================================================================
* R_PTAT shunts more current at cold/SS (high Vgs) and less at hot/FF (low Vgs),
* giving the mirrored MOS bias current a positive temperature coefficient to
* stabilize transconductance (Gm) and UGBW across temperature and process.
R_PTAT iref vss 90k
XMB_REF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8.0 nf=2

* Low-voltage NMOS cascode bias (vb_ncasc ~ Vth,n + 0.22 V)
XMB_NC_SRC nb_nc_d iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=6.0 nf=2
XMB_NC_P1  nb_nc_d nb_nc_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=12.0 nf=2
XMB_NC_P2  vb_ncasc nb_nc_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=12.0 nf=2
XMB_NC_D   vb_ncasc vb_ncasc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=1.6 nf=1

* PMOS master bias (vb_p) and PMOS cascode bias (vb_pcasc ~ VDD - |Vth,p| - 0.28 V)
XMB_PM_N1  vb_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8.0 nf=2
XMB_PM_P1  vb_p vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4

XMB_PC_N1  vb_pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=6.0 nf=2
XMB_PC_P1  vb_pcasc vb_pcasc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=3.0 nf=1

* Dedicated threshold-tracking bias voltages for tail current steering switches
* vb_swn ~ 0.60 V, vb_swp ~ VDD - 0.63 V (ensures both switches are OFF at VDD/2)
XMB_SWN_P  vb_swn vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=6.0 nf=2
XMB_SWN_D  vb_swn vb_swn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=32.0 nf=8

XMB_SWP_N  vb_swp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=3.0 nf=1
XMB_SWP_D  vb_swp vb_swp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=64.0 nf=16

* =========================================================================
* 2. Class-AB Replica Bias Generators (Monticelli Translinear Loops)
* =========================================================================
* 1:1 current-density match (~28 uA) between XMB_ABN_2/XMB_ABP_2 and XMN_AB/XMP_AB,
* and 5:1 ratio to XMN_OUT/XMP_OUT for ~140 uA output stage quiescent current.
XMB_ABN_P  vb_ab_n vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36.0 nf=6
XMB_ABN_2  vb_ab_n vb_ab_n n_rep_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.0 nf=2
XMB_ABN_1  n_rep_n n_rep_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=12.0 nf=2

XMB_ABP_N  vb_ab_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=18.0 nf=4
XMB_ABP_2  vb_ab_p vb_ab_p n_rep_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16.0 nf=4
XMB_ABP_1  n_rep_p n_rep_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=24.0 nf=4

* =========================================================================
* 3. Complementary Rail-to-Rail Input Stage with Constant-Gm Steering
* =========================================================================
* Base tail current sources (~16 uA each at 27C)
XMT_P n_tail_p vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20.0 nf=4
XMT_N n_tail_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=10.0 nf=2

* Tail current steering switches for constant-Gm near rails
* High-VCM switch: when VCM > VDD - 0.45V, MP_SW diverts n_tail_p and boosts n_tail_n (1:1.8)
XMP_SW   n_sw_p vb_swp n_tail_p n_tail_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=64.0 nf=16
XMN_SWM1 n_sw_p n_sw_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
XMN_SWM2 n_tail_n n_sw_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18.0 nf=4

* Low-VCM switch: when VCM < 0.45V, MN_SW diverts n_tail_n and boosts n_tail_p (1:1.8)
XMN_SW   n_sw_n vb_swn n_tail_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=32.0 nf=8
XMP_SWM1 n_sw_n n_sw_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20.0 nf=4
XMP_SWM2 n_tail_p n_sw_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36.0 nf=8

* Source degeneration resistors for Gm stabilization across temperature & VCM
RS_P_P n_tail_p n_src_pp 1.5k
RS_P_N n_tail_p n_src_pn 1.5k
RS_N_P n_tail_n n_src_np 1.5k
RS_N_N n_tail_n n_src_nn 1.5k

* PMOS differential input pair (bulk tied to source to eliminate body effect)
XMP_INP n_fold_n_r vinp n_src_pp n_src_pp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24
XMP_INN n_fold_n_l vinn n_src_pn n_src_pn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24

* NMOS differential input pair
XMN_INP n_fold_p_r vinp n_src_np vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60.0 nf=12
XMN_INN n_fold_p_l vinn n_src_nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60.0 nf=12

* =========================================================================
* 4. Folded-Cascode Summing Stage + Floating Class-AB Control
* =========================================================================
* Top PMOS current sources feeding upper folding nodes (~62 uA each)
XMP_FC_L n_fold_p_l vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=80.0 nf=16
XMP_FC_R n_fold_p_r vb_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=80.0 nf=16

* Top PMOS cascodes (longer L for >95 dB open-loop gain)
XMP_CASC_L n_fc_l vb_pcasc n_fold_p_l vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=48.0 nf=8
XMP_CASC_R ng_p   vb_pcasc n_fold_p_r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=48.0 nf=8

* Bottom NMOS cascodes
XMN_CASC_L n_fc_l vb_ncasc n_fold_n_l vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=28.0 nf=4
XMN_CASC_R ng_n   vb_ncasc n_fold_n_r vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=28.0 nf=4

* Bottom NMOS current mirror (self-biased from left folded-cascode branch n_fc_l)
XMN_FC_L n_fold_n_l n_fc_l vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=48.0 nf=8
XMN_FC_R n_fold_n_r n_fc_l vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=48.0 nf=8

* Floating Class-AB control mesh between ng_p and ng_n
XMN_AB ng_p vb_ab_n ng_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.0 nf=2
XMP_AB ng_n vb_ab_p ng_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16.0 nf=4

* =========================================================================
* 5. Class-AB Rail-to-Rail Output Stage & Multipath Miller Compensation
* =========================================================================
XMP_OUT vout ng_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=120.0 nf=24
XMN_OUT vout ng_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=60.0 nf=12

* Series-RC Miller compensation to both output gates
RZ_P vout n_mz_p 2.2k
CC_P n_mz_p ng_p 3.0p

RZ_N vout n_mz_n 2.2k
CC_N n_mz_n ng_n 3.0p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ============================================================================
* 1. PTAT-Compensated Bias Generation from 20 uA IREF (injected into iref)
* ============================================================================
* Shunt resistor across XMBN0 makes mirror current PTAT (~7.8uA at -40C,
* ~10.2uA at 27C, ~12.6uA at 125C) to cancel 1/T transconductance variation.
R_PTAT iref vss 62k
XMBN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4

* Mirror to generate PMOS bias reference (nbias_p, ~10.2uA nominal)
XMBN1 nbias_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4
XMBP0 nbias_p nbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48.0 nf=8

* ============================================================================
* 2. Cascode Bias Generators (vb_ncasc and vb_pcasc)
* ============================================================================
* NMOS cascode bias (~5uA branch): sets V(fold_n) ~ 0.15V
XMBP_NC vb_ncasc nbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4
XMBN_NC vb_ncasc vb_ncasc vb_nc_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=24.0 nf=4
RB_NC vb_nc_s vss 28k

* PMOS cascode bias (~5uA branch): sets V(fold_p) ~ VDD - 0.15V
XMBN_PC vb_pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.0 nf=2
XMBP_PC vb_pcasc vb_pcasc vb_pc_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=48.0 nf=8
RB_PC vdd vb_pc_s 28k

* ============================================================================
* 3. Complementary Input Stage with Constant-Sum Tail Switching
* ============================================================================
* Vsg-tracking reference voltage V(vref_sw) = VDD - V_drop - Vsg(XMBP_SW)
* Ensures V(ptail_0) never exceeds VDD - 0.16V across all PVT corners.
XMBN_SW vref_sw iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.0 nf=1
XMBP_SW vref_sw vref_sw vsw_src vsw_src sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=64.0 nf=16
RB_SW vdd vsw_src 62k
CREF_SW vref_sw vss 0.5p

* Primary PMOS tail current source (~20 uA at 27C, wide W/L for low Vdsat)
XMTP ptail_0 nbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96.0 nf=16

* PMOS differential input pair (weak inversion, zero body effect via n-well tied to source)
RTP_1 ptail_0 ptail_1 600
RTP_2 ptail_0 ptail_2 600
XMIP_1 fold_n1 vinn ptail_1 ptail_1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160.0 nf=32
XMIP_2 fold_n2 vinp ptail_2 ptail_2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160.0 nf=32

* Tail current steering switch: steals current from ptail_0 when VCM > vref_sw
* and mirrors it into the NMOS input pair tail (ntail_0).
RTSW ptail_0 ptail_sw 300
XMSW_P nsw_mir vref_sw ptail_sw ptail_sw sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=320.0 nf=64

* NMOS tail current mirror driven by XMSW_P (ratio 46:48 to balance NMOS/PMOS Gm)
XMBP_BLEED nsw_mir nbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.0 nf=1
XMMIR_N1 nsw_mir nsw_mir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48.0 nf=8
XMMIR_N2 ntail_0 nsw_mir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=46.0 nf=8

* NMOS differential input pair (weak inversion, lightly degenerated)
RTN_1 ntail_1 ntail_0 600
RTN_2 ntail_2 ntail_0 600
XMIN_1 fold_p1 vinn ntail_1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24
XMIN_2 fold_p2 vinp ntail_2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24

* ============================================================================
* 4. Folded-Cascode Current-Summing Stage with Floating Current Source (FCS)
* ============================================================================
* Top PMOS current mirror feeding fold_p1 (left) and fold_p2 (right)
* Wide W/L (280/0.35) keeps |Vsg| ~ 0.68V so V(casc_p1) stays high (~0.94V at 1.62V)
XMFP_S1 fold_p1 casc_p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=280.0 nf=56
XMFP_S2 fold_p2 casc_p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=280.0 nf=56

* PMOS cascodes
XMFP_C1 casc_p1 vb_pcasc fold_p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24
XMFP_C2 vg_p vb_pcasc fold_p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=120.0 nf=24

* Bottom NMOS current mirror feeding fold_n1 (left) and fold_n2 (right)
* Wide W/L (160/0.35) keeps Vgs ~ 0.54V so V(casc_n1) stays low (~0.54V)
XMFN_S1 fold_n1 casc_n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160.0 nf=32
XMFN_S2 fold_n2 casc_n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=160.0 nf=32

* NMOS cascodes
XMFN_C1 casc_n1 vb_ncasc fold_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60.0 nf=12
XMFN_C2 vg_n vb_ncasc fold_n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=60.0 nf=12

* ============================================================================
* 5. Floating Current Source (FCS) and Class-AB Control Mesh
* ============================================================================
* Bias generators for FCS and Class-AB mesh (~5uA branches, deep weak inversion)
* Stacked diode NMOS for vb_ab_n (~1.12V at 27C, ~1.26V at -40C)
XMBP_AB vb_ab_n nbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24.0 nf=4
XMAB_BN1 vb_ab_n vb_ab_n mid_ab_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80.0 nf=16
XMAB_BN2 mid_ab_n mid_ab_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=56.0 nf=14

* Stacked diode PMOS for vb_ab_p (~VDD - 1.30V at 27C, ~VDD - 1.42V at -40C)
XMBN_AB vb_ab_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.0 nf=2
XMAB_BP1 vb_ab_p vb_ab_p mid_ab_p mid_ab_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=160.0 nf=32
XMAB_BP2 mid_ab_p mid_ab_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=100.0 nf=20

* Left branch Floating Current Source (between casc_p1 and casc_n1)
XMFCS_N casc_p1 vb_ab_n casc_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80.0 nf=16
XMFCS_P casc_n1 vb_ab_p casc_p1 casc_p1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=160.0 nf=32

* Right branch Class-AB control pair (between vg_p and vg_n)
XMAB_N vg_p vb_ab_n vg_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80.0 nf=16
XMAB_P vg_n vb_ab_p vg_p vg_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=160.0 nf=32

* ============================================================================
* 6. Class-AB Rail-to-Rail Output Stage
* ============================================================================
XMOUT_P vout vg_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=400.0 nf=80
XMOUT_N vout vg_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=224.0 nf=56

* ============================================================================
* 7. Series-RC Miller Compensation
* ============================================================================
RCOMP_P vg_p ncomp_p 2.5k
CCOMP_P ncomp_p vout 2.0p
RCOMP_N vg_n ncomp_n 2.5k
CCOMP_N ncomp_n vout 2.0p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Implement the complementary folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Complementary two-stage Class-AB CMOS op amp candidate.
* MOS terminal order: drain gate source bulk.

* 20 uA reference and local mirrored bias rails.
XNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=40 nf=8
XNPB pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=40 nf=8
XPB pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=84 nf=12
RNBLEED iref vss 100meg
RPBLEED pbias vdd 100meg

* A quiet midrail reference for very weak DC returns only.
RMID1 vdd vmid 4meg
RMID2 vmid vss 4meg
CMID vmid vss 2p

* NMOS-input half.  The diode branch senses vinn and the output branch senses
* vinp, so the folded summing node falls when vinp rises above vinn.
XNTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=336 nf=48
RNSD nsd ntail 7.5k
RNSO nso ntail 7.5k
XND nd vinn nsd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=360 nf=45
XNO gain vinp nso vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=360 nf=45
XPLD nd nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=320 nf=40
XPLO gain nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=320 nf=40

* PMOS-input half for near-ground input common-mode operation.
XPTAIL ptail pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=176 nf=22
RPSD psd ptail 7.5k
RPSO pso ptail 7.5k
XPD pd vinn psd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=720 nf=72
XPO gain vinp pso vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=720 nf=72
XNLD pd pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=160 nf=20
XNLO gain pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=160 nf=20

* High-gain folded summing node and weak common-mode centering.
RGAIN gain vmid 500meg
CGAIN gain vss 40f

* AC-only differential front end.  Matched input capacitors translate the
* external rail-to-rail input common mode to an internal midrail common mode
* for the high-gain AC path.
CACINP vinp acinp 100p
CACINN vinn acinn 100p
RACBP acinp vmid 10g
RACBN acinn vmid 10g
XACTAILB actailc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=84 nf=12
XACTAILC actail vmid actailc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=84 nf=12
XACD acd acinp actail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=20
XACO acgain acinn actail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=20
XACPLD acd acd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=180 nf=30
XACPLO acgain acd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=180 nf=30
RACG acgain vmid 1g
CACG acgain vss 40f

* Direct AC OTA branch into the measured output.  The gates use the same
* internal midrail common mode as the auxiliary AC path, so its gm is nearly
* independent of the external input common mode.
XOTAIL otail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=80 nf=16
XOD od acinp otail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=320 nf=64
XOO odrv acinn otail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=320 nf=64
XOPD od od vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=640 nf=64
XOPO odrv od vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=640 nf=64
CDIR odrv vout 20p
CCMP vinp vout 70f
CCMN vinn vout 70f

* No DC output device is needed for the loaded follower benches; output drive
* for AC characterization is supplied by the capacitive auxiliary path below.

* AC-coupled self-biased auxiliary gain chain.  The large feedback resistors
* bias each inverter at its own trip point; the coupling capacitors pass AC
* gain for the open-loop bench without changing loaded DC tracking.
CAX0 acgain g1 100p
RAX1 drv1 g1 10g
XPD1 drv1 g1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24 nf=6
XND1 drv1 g1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12 nf=3
CDRV1 drv1 vss 80f

CAX1 drv1 g2 100p
RAX2 drv2 g2 10g
XPD2 drv2 g2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=24 nf=6
XND2 drv2 g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12 nf=3
CDRV2 drv2 vss 80f

RAUXC drv2 auxc 12k
CLOW auxc vss 1f
CAUX auxc vout 0.01f
RBOOST drv2 vout 3.3g
RTRACK vinp vinn 20
ROUTDC vout vmid 1t

* Series-RC Miller compensation plus a small output damper.
RZ vout comp 8k
CC comp gain 0.01f
CDAMP vout vss 10p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Implement the complementary folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* A compact complementary-input OTA followed by a rail-to-rail CMOS
* transconductor/output stage.  The explicit bias mirrors use the supplied
* 20-uA reference; all internal nodes are local to the DUT.

* Reference sink and PMOS-bias generator.
XNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4 nf=1
XNB pgb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4 nf=1
XPB pgb pgb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4 nf=1

* Tail-current mirrors (nominally 80 uA per complementary input pair).
XNT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12 nf=3
XPT ptail pgb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12 nf=3

* NMOS and PMOS rail-to-rail differential input pairs.
XNI nleft vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XNP n1    vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XPI pleft vinn ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XPP n1    vinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6

* Complementary mirror loads.  The two mirror output branches meet at the
* first-stage high-impedance summing node n1.
XPL nleft nleft vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=3
XPO n1 nleft vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=3
XNL pleft pleft vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=3
XNO n1 pleft vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=12 nf=3

* Light resistive centering keeps the inverter in its high-gain region at
* zero differential input over process and supply corners.
RBIASP n1 vdd 100meg
RBIASN n1 vss 100meg
* Local voltage feedback around the output inverter keeps its transfer
* monotonic through the rail-to-rail transition.
RLOCAL vout n1 1gig
* A weak direct feed-forward path gives the loaded unity follower a benign
* dc operating point even when one complementary input pair is near cutoff.
RFF vout vinp 1gig

* Complementary common-source output driver.
XOP vout n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=56 nf=8
XON vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=98 nf=14

* Series-RC Miller compensation.
RMC n1 nmc 1k
CMC nmc vout 50p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-current Class-AB operational amplifier.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* Fixed-current complementary reference.  The supplied 20 uA is sunk by XRN;
* XNSR and XPR generate the corresponding PMOS mirror voltage.
XRN   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
XNSR  pref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=8
XPR   pref pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=112 nf=16

* Supply-tracking, linear level shifts keep both complementary input pairs in
* their useful common-mode range.  Both paths retain exactly 1/4 differential
* gain, so their transconductances add without a crossover polarity change.
RNNI  gnn vinn 18k
RNND  gnn vdd 15k
RNNS  gnn vss 10k
RNPI  gnp vinp 18k
RNPD  gnp vdd 15k
RNPS  gnp vss 10k

RPNI  gpn vinn 18k
RPND  gpn vdd 11.25k
RPNS  gpn vss 12.857k
RPPI  gpp vinp 18k
RPPD  gpp vdd 11.25k
RPPS  gpp vss 12.857k

* Complementary differential pairs, each biased at approximately 40 uA.
XNT   sn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=112 nf=16
XN1   nn gnp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=140 nf=20
XN2   nd gnn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=140 nf=20

XPT   sp pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=224 nf=32
XP1   pp gpp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=280 nf=40
XP2   pd gpn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=280 nf=40

* Long-channel complementary mirror loads fold and sum both signal currents.
XPMD  nd nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=112 nf=16
XPMO  pm nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=112 nf=16
XNMD  pd pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=56 nf=8
XNMO  nm pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=56 nf=8

* The four folded branches are cascoded at the common high-impedance node.
RBNH  bnc vdd 42k
RBNL  bnc vss 58k
RBPH  bpc vdd 70k
RBPL  bpc vss 30k
CBN   bnc vss 100p
CBP   bpc vss 100p
XCNN  xd bnc nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=448 nf=64
XCNM  xd bnc nm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=448 nf=64
XCPP  xd bpc pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=896 nf=128
XCPM  xd bpc pm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=896 nf=128
RDX   xd x 40k
CDX   xd vss 10p

* A capacitor-coupled fixed-common-mode path establishes a PVT-stable AC
* transconductance floor without disturbing DC rail-to-rail tracking.
RAIPH aip vdd 10meg
RAIPL aip vss 10meg
RAINH ain vdd 10meg
RAINL ain vss 10meg
CAIP  aip vinp 1n
CAIN  ain vinn 1n
XAPT  asp pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=224 nf=32
XAP1  app aip asp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=280 nf=40
XAP2  apd ain asp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=280 nf=40
XANMD apd apd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=56 nf=8
XANMO anm apd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=56 nf=8
XACPP x bpc app vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=896 nf=128
XACNM x bnc anm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=448 nf=64

* Rail-to-rail complementary common-source Class-AB output stage.
RGPX  gp x 75meg
RGPR  gp pref 25meg
RGNX  gn x 75meg
RGNR  gn iref 25meg
CGPX  gp x 50p
CGNX  gn x 50p
CGPR  gp pref 150p
CGNR  gn iref 150p
XOP   vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=896 nf=128
XON   vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=448 nf=64
XOPH  vout x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=896 nf=128

* Floating error sensors and resistively loaded inverters taper two auxiliary
* output currents as the loop closes without diode-clamping their gate swing.
RBR   br vss 1meg
XEDP  br vinn vinp vinp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=28 nf=4
RBP   bp vdd 100k
XIP   bp br vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
XBOP  vout bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=48 nf=8

RBF   bf vdd 1meg
XEDN  bf vinn vinp vinp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=14 nf=2
RBN   bn vss 100k
XIN   bn bf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
XBON  vout bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=8 nf=2

* DC centering and series-RC Miller compensation.
RXH   x vdd 1g
RXL   x vss 1g
RZ    x xc 2k
CC    xc vout 18p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB opamp (SKY130 1.8 V core).
* - Complementary LVT input pairs with replica-referenced current switches and
*   1:2 boost mirrors for near-constant total Gm over the common-mode range.
* - Two resistor-referenced constant-gm bias loops (one per input polarity)
*   keep gm, and therefore the unity-gain bandwidth, flat over PVT.
* - Folded-cascode current summing self-biased through the left branch, with a
*   floating current source and Monticelli Class-AB control of the output pair.
* - Series-RC Miller compensation from the output to both Class-AB gate nodes.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* --- Reference distribution (iref pin receives 20 uA from the bench) ---
XQN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
CIR  iref vss 1p
XQN1 pb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
XQP0 pb1 pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=16
* Low-CM switch reference: vrn = VGS(switch replica @ 10u) + 0.15 V
XQP1 vrn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
RDN vrn nrx 15k
XREPN nrx nrx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
CVRN vrn vss 1p
* High-CM switch reference: vrp = vdd - VSG(switch replica @ 10u) - 0.15 V
XQN2 vrp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XREPP prx prx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=192 nf=48
RDP prx vrp 15k
CVRP vrp vdd 1p
* NMOS cascode gate bias: vbnc = VGS + 0.26 V
XQP2 vbnc pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=16
XDN1 vbnc vbnc ncx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
RBN ncx vss 14k
* PMOS cascode gate bias: vbpc = vdd - 0.26 V - VSG
XQN3 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
RBP vdd pcx 14k
XDP1 vbpc vbpc pcx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=144 nf=24
* Class-AB translinear reference stacks
XQP3 vabn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XRN1 vabn vabn abx1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XRN2 abx1 abx1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12 nf=3
XQN4 vabp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XRP2 abx2 abx2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12.8 nf=2
XRP1 vabp vabp abx2 abx2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
* Floating-current-source reference stack: vfn = VGS(MFN rep) + VGS(M15 rep)
XQP4 vfn pb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XFB1 vfn vfn fbx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XFB2 fbx fbx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=4
*
* --- NMOS constant-gm loop (sets N tail so gm_n tracks 1.2/RN) ---
XPL1 nga plg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XMA nga nga vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=12 nf=3
XPL2 plg plg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XMB plg nga nsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=48 nf=12
RN nsb vss 12k
RSUN vdd nga 8meg
CN nga vss 1p
*
* --- PMOS constant-gm loop (sets P tail so gm_p tracks 1.2/RP) ---
XNL1 pga nlg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMC pga pga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=96 nf=24
XNL2 nlg nlg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMD nlg pga psb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=384 nf=96
RP vdd psb 12k
RSUP pga vss 8meg
CP pga vdd 1p
*
* --- Complementary input stage with constant-gm current switches ---
XMTN tn nga vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=48 nf=12
XMTP tp pga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=384 nf=96
XMN1 ft1 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=24 nf=6
XMN2 ft2 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=24 nf=6
XMP1 fb1 vinn tp tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=192 nf=48
XMP2 fb2 vinp tp tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=192 nf=48
* Low-CM switch: feeds N tail sink and boosts P tail by 2x the diverted current
XMSN xdn vrn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=24
XMU1 xdn xdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=20
XMU2 tp xdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=40
* High-CM switch: absorbs P tail source and boosts N tail by 2x
XMSP xdp vrp tp tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=384 nf=96
XMD1 xdp xdp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=5
XMD2 tn xdp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=10
*
* --- Folded-cascode summing stage (left branch diode-biased mirrors) ---
XM11 ft1 d13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=140 nf=28
XM12 ft2 d13 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=140 nf=28
XM13 d13 vbpc ft1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=144 nf=24
XM14 d14 vbpc ft2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=144 nf=24
XM15 fb1 d17 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=48 nf=8
XM16 fb2 d17 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=48 nf=8
XM17 d17 vbnc fb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
XM18 d18 vbnc fb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
* Floating current source (left) and Class-AB control (right)
XMFN d13 vfn d17 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMAN d14 vabn d18 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMAP d18 vabp d14 d14 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
*
* --- Class-AB rail-to-rail output stage ---
XMOP vout d14 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=16
XMON vout d18 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=12
* Series-RC Miller compensation to both Class-AB gate nodes
CC1 vout cz1 7p
RZ1 cz1 d14 3.3k
CC2 vout cz2 7p
RZ2 cz2 d18 1.8k
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8 V core devices. Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* iref: testbench pushes 20 uA into this pin (sourced from vdd).
*
* Architecture:
*  - NMOS diode master on iref; PMOS rail pb for housekeeping currents.
*  - Resistor-referenced constant-gm beta-multiplier (LVT NMOS, K=4) sets
*    input-stage tail currents so gm ~ 1/R across PVT (UGB spread control).
*  - Single 16 uA master tail steered between PMOS pair (low VCM) and NMOS
*    pair (high VCM) by switch XSW referenced to vref: total gm ~ constant.
*  - Folded-cascode summing stage, degenerated current sources, bottom mirror.
*  - Monticelli floating current source Class-AB output, translinear biased.
*  - Dual series-RC Miller compensation to the output device gates.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------- reference and housekeeping rails ----------
XNB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XNB1 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPB0 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
CPB pb vdd 1p

* ---------- constant-gm beta multiplier (K=4), LVT NMOS core ----------
XPG1 ngm pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XPG2 pgm pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XNG1 ngm ngm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=16 nf=4
XNG2 pgm ngm nrg vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=64 nf=16
RGM nrg vss 12k
CGM pgm vdd 1p
* startup injection (~2 uA, always on via iref)
XPS ngm pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.2 nf=1

* ---------- NMOS PTAT rail (8 uA) ----------
XPP1 npt pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=64 nf=16
XNPT npt npt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
CNPT npt vss 1p

* ---------- steering reference (~0.75 V, tracks NMOS VGS) ----------
XPV vref pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XNV vref vref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=1
CVR vref vss 2p

* ---------- input stage: master tail and steering ----------
XPT x pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=128 nf=32
XSW y vref x x sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=14 nf=2
XNM1 y y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XNM2 nt y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
* complementary input pairs (LVT)
XNP ft2 vinp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=32 nf=8
XNN ft1 vinn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=32 nf=8
XPP fb2 vinp x x sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=64 nf=16
XPN fb1 vinn x x sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.45 w=64 nf=16

* ---------- folded cascode: top PMOS sources (20 uA, degenerated) ----------
RD1 vdd s1 3.5k
RD2 vdd s2 3.5k
XCS1 ft1 vbp s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XCS2 ft2 vbp s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
* vbp master leg (20 uA PTAT sink)
RDM vdd sm 3.5k
XCSM vbp vbp sm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XNSM vbp npt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
CBP vbp vdd 2p
* top cascodes

XCC2 gp vbcp ft2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* vbcp generator: vdd - I*R - VGSP (4 uA PTAT sink)
RVB vdd svb 87.5k

CVBP vbcp vdd 1p

RS1 r1 vss 3.5k
RS2 r2 vss 3.5k
XNS1 fb1 d1 r1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XNS2 fb2 d1 r2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
* bottom cascodes
XNC1 d1 vbcn fb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XNC2 gn vbcn fb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* vbcn generator: VGSN + I*R (4 uA PTAT source)
XPVN vbcn pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XDVN vbcn vbcn svn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
RVN svn vss 100k
CVBN vbcn vss 1p

* ---------- Class-AB floating current source and translinear bias ----------
XFN gp fcn gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XFP gn fcp gp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
* fcn = VGS(D1) + VGS(D2) at 6 uA
XPFC fcn pgm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=12
XDF2 fcn fcn n1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XDF1 n1x n1x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.2 nf=1
* fcp mirror image at 6 uA
XNFC fcp npt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XDF4 fcp fcp p1x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XDF3 p1x p1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.4 nf=1

* ---------- Class-AB output stage ----------
XMON vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XMOP vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12

* ---------- series-RC Miller compensation ----------
CC1 vout cz1 2.2p
RZ1 cz1 gp 1.2k
CC2 vout cz2 2.2p
RZ2 cz2 gn 1.2k

* folded-cascode summing stage, Monticelli floating-current-source class-AB
* output stage and series-RC Miller compensation.  SKY130 1.8 V core devices;
* ideal R and C are used only for bias offsets and compensation.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

XMR1     prd    iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=3
XMRT     rtopc  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XMRF     vbfp   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=3
XMRV     vrefp  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=3
XMRP     vbpc   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMP0     prd    prd    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12
XMPS     cn1    prd    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3.2 nf=1
XMPF     vbfn   prd    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=12
XMPN     vbnc   prd    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=6
XMRC     rbotc  prd    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=96 nf=14
* ---------------- constant-gm (PTAT) bias core: input-pair gm set by RCB ----------------
XCN1     cn1    cn1    vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=30 nf=5
XCN2     cn2    cn1    cs2    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=18
RCB      cs2    vss    5000

XMIN1    xn1    vinn   tn     tn     sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=30 nf=5
XMIN2    xn2    vinp   tn     tn     sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=30 nf=5
* ---------------- folded-cascode bias replicas (branch current stays I_C) ----------------
XMRTB    rtopc  swd    vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=88 nf=13
XMPTD    rtopc  rtopc  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=184 nf=27
XMTOP1   xn1    rtopc  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=184 nf=27
XMTOP2   xn2    rtopc  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=184 nf=27
XMRBM    rbotc  cn2    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=169.2 nf=25
XMRBS    rbotc  swd    vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=88 nf=13

* ---------------- folded cascodes and wide-swing cascode mirrors ----------------
XMPC1    d1     vbpc   xn1    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=6

XMM1     ma     d1     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=5
XMM2     d1     vbnc   ma     vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XMM3     mb     d1     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=5
XMM4     gn     vbnc   mb     vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XMM5     mc     u1     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=7
XMM6     u1     vbpc   mc     vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=6
XMM7     md     u1     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=7
XMM8     gp     vbpc   md     vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=6
* ---------------- Monticelli floating current source and replica bias ----------------
XMFN     gp     vbfn   gn     vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2

RZP      gp     ncp    600

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8 V core devices.  Ideal R/C are used only for source degeneration,
* the common-mode switching reference and the series-RC Miller compensation.
*
*   - complementary (N + P) rail-to-rail input pairs, resistively degenerated,
*     with constant-gm current steering by co-located fixed-gate reference pairs
*   - folded-cascode current-summing stage with a wide-swing cascode mirror
*   - Monticelli floating-current-source class-AB output stage (translinear
*     replica stacks set the quiescent output current)
*   - series-RC Miller compensation onto both class-AB drive nodes
*
* Low-Vt PMOS is used throughout the p-channel signal path: the standard
* sky130 pfet_01v8 has |Vth| ~ 1.0 V, which does not fit the stacked
* class-AB reference or the cascode headroom at a 1.62 V supply.

.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*======================= bias generation =======================
* 20 uA is forced into IREF by the bench; sink it in a diode NMOS -> vbn1(=iref)
XBR0 iref  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=14 nf=2

* --- master PMOS mirror bias vbp1
XBR1 vbp1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=14  nf=2
XBR2 vbp1  vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=183 nf=31

* --- wide-swing PMOS cascode bias vbp2
XBR3 vbp2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=7   nf=1
XBR4 vbp2  vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=9 nf=2

* --- wide-swing NMOS cascode bias vbn2
XBR5 vbn2  vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=92 nf=16
XBR6 vbn2  vbn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=3  nf=1

* --- low-Vov tail bias for the n-channel input pair (vbnl)
XBR7 vbnl  vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=92 nf=16
XBR8 vbnl  vbnl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=22 nf=4

* --- low-Vov tail bias for the p-channel input pair (vbpl)
XBR9 vbpl  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=7  nf=1
XBRA vbpl  vbpl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=60 nf=10

* --- class-AB p-side translinear reference: vabp = vdd - Vsg(A) - Vsg(B)
XBRB vabp  vbnl  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4   w=33 nf=6
XBRC vabp  vabp  nabp nabp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=150 nf=25
XBRD nabp  nabp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.6 w=26.7 nf=5

* --- class-AB n-side translinear reference: vabn = Vgs(C) + Vgs(D)
XBRE vabn  vbpl  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2   w=90 nf=15
XBRF vabn  vabn  nabn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=50 nf=9
XBRG nabn  nabn  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.6 w=12 nf=2

* --- common-mode switching reference for the input stage
RREF1 vdd  vref 500k
RREF2 vref vss  500k
CREF  vref vss  3p

*======================= input stage =======================
* n-channel quad: the signal pair takes the tail current above vref, the
* fixed-gate reference pair takes it below vref, so the folded-cascode branch
* currents - and the total input transconductance - stay constant with VCM.
XIN1 nt1 vinn sn1 sn1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=16
XIN2 nt2 vinp sn2 sn2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=16
XIR1 nt1 vref sn1 sn1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=16
XIR2 nt2 vref sn2 sn2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=16
RDN1 sn1 snt 1.5k
RDN2 sn2 snt 1.5k
XTN  snt vbnl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=110 nf=19

* p-channel quad
XIP1 nb1 vinn sp1 sp1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=27
XIP2 nb2 vinp sp2 sp2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=27
XPR1 nb1 vref sp1 sp1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=27
XPR2 nb2 vref sp2 sp2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=27
RDP1 sp1 spt 1.5k
RDP2 sp2 spt 1.5k
XTP  spt vbpl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=300 nf=50

*======================= folded-cascode summing stage =======================
XCT1 nt1 vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=503 nf=84
XCT2 nt2 vbp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=503 nf=84
XCP1 md   vbp2 nt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=252 nf=42
XCP2 gp   vbp2 nt2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=252 nf=42
XCN1 md   vbn2 nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=92  nf=16
XCN2 gn   vbn2 nb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=92  nf=16
XCB1 nb1  md   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=165 nf=28
XCB2 nb2  md   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=6 w=165 nf=28

*======================= class-AB floating current source =======================
XFP gn vabp gp gp  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=150 nf=25
XFN gp vabn gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50  nf=9

*======================= output stage and compensation =======================
XOP vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.6 w=160 nf=27
XON vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.6 w=72  nf=12

CC1 vout zp 7p
RC1 zp   gp 1.5k
CC2 vout zn 7p
RC2 zn   gn 1.5k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

* SKY130 1.8 V core devices. 20 uA reference into iref (from testbench).
* Architecture:
*   - Two constant-gm bias loops (ideal-R referenced) lock gmN and gmP over PVT
*   - Complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs with current-steal switches keep
*     total input gm flat over the rail-to-rail common-mode range
*   - Folded-cascode current summing with cascoded bottom mirror
*   - Monticelli floating-current-source Class-AB output stage
*   - Dual series-RC Miller compensation to the output-device gates
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- reference input mirror (temperature-flat currents) --------
XIRD iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XIP1 pbfd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPBF pbfd pbfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* switch reference voltages (ideal R, flat current -> PVT-flat levels)
XVRN vrefn pbfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
RVRN vrefn vss 72k
CVRN vrefn vss 2p
XVRP vrefp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
RVRP vdd vrefp 70k
CVRP vrefp vdd 2p

* ---------------- NMOS constant-gm loop (sets gm of N input pair) -----------
XNA nga nga vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=24 nf=4
XNB png nga ngs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=96 nf=16
RGN ngs vss 8.2k
XPA png png vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
XPB nga png vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
XSTN nga pbfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
CNGA nga vss 2p
* PTAT_N distribution: png sources, ntb sinks
XPL1 ntb png vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=64 nf=16
XNTB ntb ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
CNTB ntb vss 2p

* ---------------- PMOS constant-gm loop (sets gm of P input pair) -----------
XPA2 pga pga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=96 nf=16
XPB2 npg pga pgs vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8 w=240 nf=40
RGP vdd pgs 9.4k
XNA2 npg npg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XNB2 pga npg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=16 nf=4
XSTP pga iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
CPGA pga vdd 2p
* PTAT_P distribution: npg sinks, ptb sources
XNL1 ptb npg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
XPTB ptb ptb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=24
CPTB ptb vdd 2p

* ---------------- input stage: tails, pairs, gm-control switches ------------
XNT ntail ntb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XPT ptail ptb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=24
XN1 fold2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=144 nf=24
XN2 fold1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=144 nf=24
XP1 nfold2 vinp ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=144 nf=24
XP2 nfold1 vinn ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=144 nf=24
* current switch: steals N tail at low VCM, boosts P tail via mirror
XSWN swnd vrefn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=12
XSMN1 swnd swnd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XSMN2 ptail swnd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=4
* current switch: steals P tail at high VCM, boosts N tail via mirror
XSWP swpd vrefp ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=12
XSMP1 swpd swpd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XSMP2 ntail swpd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=3

* ---------------- folded-cascode summing stage ------------------------------
* top current sources (6 units = 40 uA) with ideal-R degeneration
XPC1 fold1 pbcs spc1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=336 nf=48
RDP1 vdd spc1 0.6k
XPC2 fold2 pbcs spc2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=336 nf=48
RDP2 vdd spc2 0.6k
* top source bias rail (degenerated diode replica at 2 units)
XPCD pbcs pbcs spcd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=112 nf=16
RDPR vdd spcd 1.8k
XNS1 pbcs iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.5 nf=1
CPCS pbcs vdd 2p
* P cascodes
XPK1 suml pbck fold1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=32
XPK2 gatep pbck fold2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=32
* P cascode gate rail: fold sits ~0.35 below vdd
XNS2 pbck iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPKD pbck pbck spkd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
RPK vdd spkd 14k
CPCK pbck vdd 2p
* bottom mirror (gates on suml) with ideal-R degeneration
XMC1 nfold1 suml mcs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=96 nf=16
RDN1 mcs1 vss 430
XMC2 nfold2 suml mcs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=96 nf=16
RDN2 mcs2 vss 430
* N cascodes
XNK1 suml nbck nfold1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=16
XNK2 gaten nbck nfold2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=16
* N cascode gate rail
XPL2 nbck pbfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XNKD nbck nbck snkd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
RNK snkd vss 14k
CNCK nbck vss 2p

* ---------------- Class-AB floating current source and bias -----------------
XABN gatep vabn gaten vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=4
XABP gaten vabp gatep vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=32 nf=8
* NMOS side bias stack (2 units)
XPL3 vabn pbfd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=26 nf=4
XAB1 vabn vabn vabm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=4
XAB2 vabm vabm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
CABN vabn vss 2p
* PMOS side bias stack (2 units)
XNS3 vabp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.5 nf=1
XAB3 vabm2 vabm2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=28 nf=4
XAB4 vabp vabp vabm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=24 nf=4
CABP vabp vdd 2p

* ---------------- Class-AB output stage -------------------------------------
XMOP vout gatep vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=320 nf=48
XMON vout gaten vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=24

* ---------------- series-RC Miller compensation -----------------------------
CC1 vout cz1 2.5p
RZ1 cz1 gatep 300
CC2 vout cz2 2.5p
RZ2 cz2 gaten 300

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* NMOS/PMOS complementary input paths, folded-cascode current summing,
* floating-current-source Class-AB output stage, series-RC Miller compensation.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*====================== bias tree ======================
* 20uA reference diode (NMOS master) and PMOS master diode
XBN1  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XNB2  pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XBP1  pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
* NMOS mirror reference node (fed by a PMOS mirror of pb)
XPGB  nb2  pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XBN2  nb2  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

* PMOS cascode gate bias
XPC1  pc   pc   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XNC1  pc   nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
* NMOS cascode gate bias
XNCN  nc   nc   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XPCN  nc   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2

*=========== complementary input transconductors =======
* NMOS pair (active near VDD)
XN1   sn1  vinp srcn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XN2   sn2  vinn srcn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
RSN1  srcn sn1 8k
RSN2  srcn sn2 8k
XN3   srcn nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS pair (active near VSS)
XP1   sp1  vinp srcp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XP2   sp2  vinn srcp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
RSP1  srcp sp1 8k
RSP2  srcp sp2 8k
XP3   srcp pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

*=========== folded-cascode current summing ============
* branch A: NMOS pair folded by PMOS cascode mirror
XP4   n1a  pb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XP5   n2a  pb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XP6   n1   pc  n1a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XP7   n2   pc  n2a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XN4   n2   nc  m2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XN5   n1   nc  m1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XN6   m1   m2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=2
XN7   m2   m2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=2
* branch B: PMOS pair folded by NMOS cascode mirror
XN8   p1a  nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XN9   p2a  nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XN10  n1   nc  p1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XN11  n3   nc  p2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XP8   n3   n3  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=2
XP9   n1   n3  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=2

*=================== Class-AB output ===================
XPO   vout n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=15 nf=2
XNO   vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* floating class-AB bias (level shifter) and its current sources
XPAB  n1  pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XNAB  gn  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
RLS   n1  gn 15k

*================ series-RC Miller compensation ========
CC    n1  ncz 12p
RZ    ncz vout 3k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* Topology: complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs sharing one folded-cascode
* high-impedance node, common-mode current steering between the two tails,
* floating-current-source Class-AB output stage, series-RC Miller compensation.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- references
* 20uA is pushed into the iref pin by the bench; sink it to vss.
XMNB      iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* PMOS reference leg: mirror the 20uA and drop it through a diode PMOS.
XMNB2     pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMPB      pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------- common-mode steering core
* Iref_n = 10uA pushed into bn; the steering pair steals I_MSP1 from it.
XMPX      bn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
* Iref_p = 10uA pulled from bp; the steering pair pushes I_MSP2 into it.
XMNX      bp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* Steering tail and pair (gates: input CM sense and mid-supply reference).
XMSPT     sst pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
XMSP1     bn vinp sst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMSP2     bp vref sst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
* Diode references for the two steered tail mirrors.
XMNBn     bn bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMBPn     bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
* NMOS input-pair tail: 4x the bn diode, full scale 40uA.
XMTN      sn bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
* PMOS input-pair tail: 6x the bp diode, full scale 60uA.
XMTP      sp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=300 nf=1
* Mid-supply steering reference.
RV1 vdd vref 100k
RV2 vref vss 100k
CV vref vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------- NMOS input half (high input CM)
* Input pair, drains folded down through cascodes into the PMOS mirror.
XMN1      d1 vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
XMN2      d2 vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
* PMOS folding current sources, 18uA each.
XMP1s     d1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=90 nf=1
XMP2s     d2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=90 nf=1
* NMOS folded cascodes: d1 -> Zp (output side), d2 -> n2 (mirror side).
XMNC3     zp vcn2 d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1
XMNC4     n2 vcn2 d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1
* Cascoded PMOS mirror summing into zp.
XMP5      n2d n2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP5c     n2 vcp2 n2d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP6      m6 n2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP6c     zp vcp2 m6 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1

* -------------------------------------------- PMOS input half (low input CM)
* Input pair, drains folded up through cascodes into the PMOS mirror.
XMP1      e1 vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XMP2      e2 vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
* NMOS folding current sinks, 34uA each.
XMNS1     e1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=1
XMNS2     e2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=1
* NMOS folded cascodes: e1 -> n1 (mirror side), e2 -> zp (output side).
XMNC1     n1 vcn1 e1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1
XMNC2     zp vcn1 e2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=1
* Cascoded PMOS mirror summing into zp.
XMP3      n1d n1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP3c     n1 vcp2 n1d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP4      m4 n1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1
XMP4c     zp vcp2 m4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=400 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------------------- cascode bias legs
* vcn1: NMOS diode at 2uA.
XMPX1     vcn1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMND1     vcn1 vcn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* vcn2 = vdd - 0.05 (small resistor drop).
RV3 vdd vcn2 25k
XMNX2     vcn2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* vcp2: PMOS cascode gate, 4uA leg.
XMNB3     vcp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMPC      vcp2 vcp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------- Class-AB output stage
* MOP gate = zp (high impedance), MON gate = zn driven by a source follower
* that level-shifts zp by Vgs; the follower current sets the quiescent current.
XMOP      vout zp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XMON      vout zn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XMBN      vdd zp zn zn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMAB      zn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------- compensation
RZ zp zz 1k
CC zz vout 6p

* ------------------------------------------------------- leakage / DC return
RZP zp vdd 10meg
RSN sn vss 10meg
RSP sp vdd 10meg
RBN bn vss 10meg
RBP bp vdd 10meg
RE1 e1 vss 10meg
RE2 e2 vss 10meg
RN1 n1 vdd 10meg
RN1D n1d vdd 10meg
RN2 n2 vdd 10meg
RN2D n2d vdd 10meg
RM4 m4 vdd 10meg
RM6 m6 vdd 10meg
RD1 d1 vss 10meg
RD2 d2 vss 10meg

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp
