taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8V core devices; 1.62V..1.98V supply; 20uA reference current input.
* Stage 1: complementary NMOS/PMOS input paths folded into a single
*          current-summing cascode node.  Stage 2: floating-current-source
*          Class-AB output.  Compensation: series-RC Miller network.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
XB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=2
XB2 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=2
XB3 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4

* ---------------- cascode gate bias ----------------
RCP vdd vcp 21k
XCP3 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4
XCN3 vcn vcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XCN4 vcn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=400 nf=4

* ---------------- rail-to-rail input common-mode steering ----------------
* The steering pair splits its tail between two identical low-impedance
* PMOS-diode nodes; each diode current is mirrored to become one of the two
* input-pair tail currents.  The two tail currents therefore always sum to a
* constant while each swings from 0 to the full tail, so the total input gm
* stays nearly flat from rail to rail.  Bulk of each input pair is tied to its
* own source so no body effect limits the usable common-mode range.
XC1 sda vmid scm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=2
XC2 sdb vinp scm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=2
XC3 scm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=6
RD1 vdd vmid 100k
RD2 vmid vss 100k
CV1 vmid vss 5p
XDA sda sda vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XDB sdb sdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
RSA sda vdd 4meg
RSB sdb vdd 4meg
* PMOS pair tail: mirror of the vinp-side steering drain
XMA sp sda vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
* NMOS pair tail reference (vmid steering side)
XMB xn sdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XB4 xn xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=6
XMT sn xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=600 nf=6
RXN xn vss 4meg

* ---------------- NMOS input path ----------------
XM1 A vinp sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=1
XM2 B vinn sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=1
XM3 A pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=880 nf=4
XM4 B pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=880 nf=4
XM5 n1 vcp A vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XM6 D vcp B vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XM7 D D vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=2
XM8 n8 D vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=2
XMC8 n1 vcn n8 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4

* ---------------- PMOS input path ----------------
XM9 E vinp sp sp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=24 nf=1
XM10 F vinn sp sp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=24 nf=1
XM11 E iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4
XM12 F iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4
XM13 n1 vcn E vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4
XM14 H vcn F vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=4
XM15 H H vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XM16 n16 H vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4
XMC16 n1 vcp n16 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=440 nf=4

* ---------------- floating-current-source Class-AB output ----------------
XDP x1 x1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=908 nf=4
RX x1 x2 23k
XDN x2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=416 nf=4
XBS nz1 x1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=908 nf=4
XBSC gp vcp nz1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=880 nf=4
XBS2 nz2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=416 nf=4
XBS2C n1 vcn nz2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=800 nf=4
RF gp n1 23k
XMP vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=908 nf=4
XMN vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=416 nf=4

* ---------------- series-RC Miller compensation ----------------
CCZ vout nzc 25p
RRZ nzc n1 2k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

XMBN nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=1
* ---------------- Path N: NMOS pair, folded down with PMOS cascodes ----
* tail sink 90uA
XMNT SN iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=180 nf=1
* input pair with source degeneration
XMNN1 Xn1 vinn ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=1
XMNN2 Xn2 vinp ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=1
RDN1 ns1 SN 1000
RDN2 ns2 SN 1000
* folding current sources 80uA
XMPF1 Xn1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=640 nf=1
XMPF2 Xn2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=640 nf=1
* PMOS cascodes
XMPC1 Dn1 nbcp Xn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
XMPC2 Y nbcp Xn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
* cascode bias (Vov~0.34 at 20uA)
XMBPC nbcp nbcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.7 nf=1
XMBPCN nbcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=1
* NMOS mirror to output node
XMND1 Dn1 Dn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=480 nf=1
XMNO2 YmidN Dn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=490 nf=1
XMNCASN Y nbnc YmidN vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
* ---------------- Path P: PMOS pair, folded up with NMOS cascodes ----
* tail source 90uA
XMPT SP nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=360 nf=1
* input pair (bulk tied to common source)
XMPP1 Xp1 vinn ps1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=1000 nf=1
XMPP2 Xp2 vinp ps2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=1000 nf=1
RDP1 ps1 SP 1000
RDP2 ps2 SP 1000
* folding sinks 80uA
XMNF1 Xp1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=320 nf=1
XMNF2 Xp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=320 nf=1
* NMOS cascodes
XMNC1 Dp1 nbnc Xp1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
XMNC2 Y nbnc Xp2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
* cascode bias (Vov~0.55 at 20uA)
XMBNC nbnc nbnc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMBNCP nbnc nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=1
* PMOS mirror to output node
XMPD1 Dp1 Dp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=1
XMPO2 YmidP Dp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=400 nf=1
XMNCASP Y nbcp2 YmidP vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
XMDCP Dp1 nbcp2 DpM vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=1
* ---------------- output stage ----------------
XMCS vout Y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=320 nf=1
XMPL vout nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=960 nf=2
* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
CB1 nbnc vss 10p
CB2 nbcp vdd 10p
CB3 nbp vdd 10p
* low PMOS cascode bias for matched Vds
XPBC nbcp2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=1
RBC nbcp2 vss 20k
CB4 nbcp2 vss 10p
CC1 Y nz 30p
RZ1 nz vout 1000
* ---------------- mid-CM detector: enables CX only near VDD/2 ----------------
* detl high when vinp > ~Vthn
XSL0 dl0 vinp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=10 w=2 nf=1
RDL0 vdd dl0 1meg
XILP detl dl0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
XILN detl dl0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1 nf=1

XSH0 dh0 vinp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=8 nf=1
RDH0 dh0 vss 1meg

XCSW1 sw detl m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8 V core low-Vt devices.  Ideal R/C are used only for the bias
* references and the Miller compensation network.
*
*   - complementary NMOS/PMOS weak-inversion input pairs whose two tail
*     currents are steered by the input common mode with a constant sum,
*     giving a constant total input Gm from rail to rail
*   - PTAT (beta-multiplier) tail reference so that Gm ~ ln(K)/R is also
*     constant over process and temperature
*   - folded-cascode current summing with a wide-swing cascode mirror
*   - Monticelli floating-current-source class-AB output stage
*   - series-RC Miller compensation to both output-device gates
*
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*======================================================================
* 1. fixed 20 uA reference (the 20 uA port current is forced into iref)
*======================================================================
XB01 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=6 m=8 mult=8
XB02 npg  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=6 m=8 mult=8
XB03 npg  npg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=24 mult=24

*======================================================================
* 2. cascode gate biases
*======================================================================
* pbc = VDD - Vsg(cascode replica) - 20u*RPB  ->  fixed saturation margin
XB04 pcd  pcd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=36 mult=36
RPB  pcd  pbc  14k
XB05 pbc  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=6 m=8 mult=8
* nbc = Vgs(cascode replica) + 20u*RNB
XB06 ncd  ncd  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=6 m=16 mult=16
RNB  nbc  ncd  12k
XB07 nbc  npg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=24 mult=24

*======================================================================
* 3. PTAT (constant-Gm) core + start-up
*======================================================================
XT01 ptn1 ptn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=4 mult=4
XT02 ptn2 ptn1 ptb  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=32 mult=32
RPT  ptb  vss 18.7k
XT03 ptn1 ptn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=6 mult=6
XT04 ptn2 ptn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=6 mult=6
XT05 sud  npg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=6 m=2 mult=2
XT06 sud  ptn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=4 mult=4
XT07 ptn2 sud  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 m=1 mult=1

*======================================================================
* 4. common-mode sense, steering reference, tail steering pair
*======================================================================
RCM1 vinp vcm  2meg
RCM2 vinn vcm  2meg
RVR1 vdd  vref 1.06meg
RVR2 vref vss  0.94meg

XS01 da   vcm  st  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 m=14 mult=14
XS02 db   vref st  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 m=14 mult=14
XS03 st   ptn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=16 mult=16
XS04 da   da   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=24 mult=24
XS05 db   db   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=24 mult=24
XS06 s1   da   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=12 mult=12
XS07 s2   da   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=12 mult=12
XS08 sp   db   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=31 mult=31
XS09 sn   db   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=7 m=24 mult=24
XS10 sn   ptn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=16 mult=16
RSN  sn   vss 20meg
RSP  sp   vdd 20meg

*======================================================================
* 5. complementary input pairs
*======================================================================
XI01 s1 vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=10 mult=10
XI02 s2 vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 m=10 mult=10
XI03 y1 vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 m=29 mult=29
XI04 y2 vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 m=29 mult=29

*======================================================================
* 6. folded-cascode summing stage
*======================================================================

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode operational amplifier.
* Top-level interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference / bias generation
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMNBIAS  bp_d iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMPBIAS  bp_d bp_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
C_BP     bp_d vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input common-mode sensing and tail-current steering
*   s_vcm = 0.9*VCM is compared with vref = 0.3*VDD.  The PMOS input
*   pair receives the tail current at low VCM, the NMOS pair at high
*   VCM; the sum of the two tail currents is held constant.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
R_CM1    vinp s_vcm 100k
R_CM2    s_vcm vss 900k
R_VR1    vdd vref 700k
R_VR2    vref vss 300k
C_VR     vref vss 1p

XMPST    ts bp_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMPS1    d1 s_vcm ts vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMPS2    d2 vref ts vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMN1D    d1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMN2D    d2 d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMN1M    mpg_d d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMPMD    mpg_d mpg_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
C_D1     d1 vss 1p
C_D2     d2 vss 1p
C_MPG    mpg_d vss 1p

* Input-pair tail current sources
XMPTI    tp mpg_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=240 nf=1
XMNTI    tn d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=42 nf=1
R_TP     tp vdd 10meg
R_TN     tn vss 10meg

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Complementary input pairs (source degeneration 500 ohm)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP1     pa_l vinp sp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=1
XMP2     pa_r vinn sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=1
RSP1     sp1 tp 2000
RSP2     sp2 tp 2000
XMN1     na_l vinp sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMN2     na_r vinn sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
RSN1     sn1 tn 2000
RSN2     sn2 tn 2000

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folding current mirrors
*   The NMOS sinks track the PMOS-pair current (half of its tail) plus
*   a fixed pedestal.  The PMOS sources track the NMOS-pair current
*   plus a pedestal.  This holds the cascode currents constant while
*   the input common mode moves between the rails.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPTC    fcn mpg_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=60 nf=1
XMPIQN   fcn bp_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=60 nf=1
XMNFD    fcn fcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=80 nf=1
XMNFL1   pa_l fcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=80 nf=1
XMNFL2   pa_r fcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=80 nf=1
C_FN     fcn vss 2p

XMNTC    fcp d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=30 nf=1
XMNIQP   fcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=9 nf=1
XMPGD    fcp fcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=600 nf=1
XMPGL1   na_l fcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=600 nf=1
XMPGL2   na_r fcp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=600 nf=1
C_FP     fcp vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded cascodes.  out_l is the high-impedance single-ended output;
* out_r is terminated by a diode-connected PMOS whose mirror adds the
* right-branch signal current into out_l.  This performs the
* differential-to-single-ended conversion without a CM feedback loop.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNC1    out_l vbnc pa_l vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=1
XMNC2    out_r vbnc pa_r vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=160 nf=1
XMPC1    out_l vbpc na_l vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=640 nf=1
XMPC2    out_r vbpc na_r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=640 nf=1

* Right-branch diode load and mirror to the single-ended output
XMPDI    out_r out_r vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=800 nf=1
XMPMR    m_p out_r vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=800 nf=1
XMPMRC   out_l vbpc m_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=960 nf=1
XMPMRC2  out_l vbpc m_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=960 nf=1
XMBD1    m_b1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=54 nf=1
XMBD1C   out_r vbnc m_b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=54 nf=1
XMBD2    m_b iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=54 nf=1
XMBD2C   out_l vbnc m_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=54 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias voltages
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
R_BNC1   vdd vbnc 860k
R_BNC2   vbnc vss 1140k
C_BNC    vbnc vss 2p

* PMOS cascode bias: VDD minus two PMOS diode drops, tracking Vth.
XMPB1    vb1 vb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=320 nf=1
XMPB2    vbpc vbpc vb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=320 nf=1
XMNBP    vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1
C_VB1    vb1 vdd 1p
C_VBP    vbpc vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output stage: PMOS common source with biased NMOS current sink
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPO     vout out_l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=400 nf=1
XMNO     vout ir_bias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=420 nf=1
R_IB     ir_bias iref 10k
C_IB     ir_bias vss 5p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series-RC Miller compensation
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
CCOMP    out_l nz 12p
RZCOMP   nz vout 4k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8 V core devices, ideal compensation passives.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias core
* 20 uA reference diode and PMOS/NMOS bias translations
XREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=4
XMP0   pbp  pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMN0   pbp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=4
* 60 uA NMOS sink reference
XMP1   nb2  pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
XMN1   nb2  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
* cascode bias chains (20 uA each)
XMP2   a1   a1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
* level-shifted PMOS cascode bias: vp1 = pbp - I*RS
XVP1S  vp1  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=4
RS     a1   vp1  13k
XMB3   a2   pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=6
R4     a2   vb2  14.34k
R5     vb2  vp2  12.33k
R6     vp2  vss  11.33k
* NMOS cascode-gate reference: tracks the NMOS Vth, offset by I*RGM
XMPG   vgn  pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
RGM    vgn  vgmn 44k
XMNG   vgmn vgmn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=10
* ------------------------------------------------------- complementary input
* NMOS input pair, current-source tail (20 uA)
XMN_L  xl  vinn sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=10
XMN_R  xr  vinp sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=10
XMNT   sn  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=200 nf=2
RTL    sn  vss 300k
* PMOS input pair, current-source tail (20 uA)
XMP_L  yl  vinn sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=10
XMP_R  yr  vinp sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=800 nf=10
XMPT   vdd pbp  sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=16 w=120 nf=2
RTP    sp  vdd 12k
* ------------------------------------------- NMOS path folded cascode summing
XPB_L  xl  pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=8
XPB_R  xr  pbp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=8
XPC_L  zl  vp1  xl  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XPC_R  o   vp1  xr  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=160 nf=8
XMN3   zl  zl   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=60 nf=10
XMN4   sr  zl   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=60 nf=10
XMN5   o   vgn  sr  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=10
* ------------------------------------------- PMOS path folded cascode summing
XNBS_L yd_l nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XNBS_R yd_r nb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=6
XNBSC_L yl vbn yd_l vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=10
XNBSC_R yr vbn yd_r vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=10
RVBN1 vdd vbn 1meg
RVBN2 vbn vss 0.7meg
XNC3   wl  vb2  yl  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=10
XNC4   o   vb2  yr  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=10
XMP3   wl  wl   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=6
XMP4   ur  wl   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=6
XMP5   o   vp2  ur  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=320 nf=8
* --------------------------------------------------- class-A output stage
* fixed PMOS current source, large NMOS driver steered by the first stage
XMPO   vout pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=880 nf=22
XMNO   vout o   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=160 nf=4

RZ     nz   vout 1.5k
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier (SKY130 1.8V core).
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network
* iref absorbs the external 20uA reference via the NMOS diode XNREF.
* node_bp is the PMOS gate bias for the P tails (regular PMOS, Vsg~1.22V).
* iref doubles as the NMOS gate bias for the N tail.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5
XNBPN node_bp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5
XNBPP node_bp node_bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=5
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Complementary input pairs, mirror-sum folded at nout
* NMOS pair (regular) active for VCM > ~0.6 V (Vgs~0.79V @ 7uA/dev)
* PMOS pair (low-VT) active for VCM < ~0.8 V; regular PMOS tail limits
* the pair source node to ~1.55 V so the PMOS pair cuts off before VDD/2,
* keeping each measured CM point on a single pair (gm1 stays ~constant).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XTN stn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=6
XM1n node_ym vinp stn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XM2n nout vinn stn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XTP stp node_bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=6
XM1p node_xn vinp stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 nf=3
XM2p nout vinn stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 nf=3
* PMOS current mirror (load of the NMOS pair)
XMPD node_ym node_ym vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XMPO nout node_ym vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
* NMOS current mirror (load of the PMOS pair)
XMND node_xn node_xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XMNO nout node_xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Floating-current-source Class-AB output stage
* XMDP/XMDN convert the first-stage voltage (nout) into the AB drive
* current; XMPF/XMNF form the floating source that sets the quiescent
* class-AB spacing between the output gate nodes ngp/ngn.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMDP ngp nout vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMDN ngn nout vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMPF nmid nmid ngp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=2
XMNF nmid nmid ngn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XMOP vout ngp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XMON vout ngn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series-RC Miller compensation (nulls the RHP zero of the output stage)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
Cc nout vmiller 8p
Rc vmiller vout 5k
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail class-AB operational amplifier, SKY130 1.8V core.
* Two complementary first-stage halves driving one high-impedance node "va":
*   - PMOS-input half (active for LOW common mode): PMOS pair + NMOS mirror
*     load. va is touched only by drains (pair drain || mirror-out drain), so it
*     stays high-impedance.
*   - NMOS-input half (active for HIGH/mid common mode): NMOS pair folds into a
*     PMOS cascode (fold = source) up to an NMOS mirror. The cascode DRAIN and
*     the mirror-out DRAIN sit at va -- both high-impedance.
* The output common-source inverts va; ideal R/C give Miller compensation.
* Each half auto-disconnects from va when its pair is cut off (mirror gate
* collapses), so the halves complement without fighting.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- Bias reference ----------------
* 20 uA flows vdd -> iref -> diode NMOS -> vss. iref = NMOS mirror gate,
* bp = PMOS mirror gate.
Xbref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
Xpdiode bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
Xpsink bp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* nbcas: stacked NMOS diodes; only used as a quiet bias tap (cascode gates
* that need a voltage near the middle of the mirror stack).
Xnbias nbcas bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=15 nf=3
Xnd1 nbcas nbcas nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xnd2 nd1 nd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* pbcasN: gate of the NMOS-input column PMOS cascodes (fold ~1.6 V).
XpbcasN pbcasN pbcasN vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XpcasrcN pbcasN bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=15 nf=3

* ---------------- PMOS-input pair + mirror-load stage ----------------
* Pair tail ~32 uA. Active for VCM below ~0.8 V.
Xtp ptail bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xmp1 f1p vinn ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
Xmp2 va  vinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XmirP1 f1p f1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4
XmirP2 va f1p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4

* ---------------- NMOS-input folded-cascode stage ------------------------
* Pair tail ~24 uA. Active for VCM above ~0.7 V.
Xtn ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
Xmn1 f1n vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmn2 f2n vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* Fold current sources (PMOS, from VDD).
Xtnc1 f1n bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=15 nf=3
Xtnc2 f2n bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=15 nf=3
* PMOS cascodes: fold = source, mirror node = drain.
XcascN1 y1n pbcasN f1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XcascN2 va  pbcasN f2n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* NMOS mirror load.
XmirN1 y1n y1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4
XmirN2 va y1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4

* ---------------- Output stage (inverting common source) ----------------
Xdrv vout va vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=250 nf=50
Xpcs_out vout bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=60 nf=15

* ---------------- Series-RC Miller compensation ----------------
Rz va vaz 2k
Cc vout vaz 5p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
*
* Device thresholds in this SKY130 continuous model:  nfet Vth=0.52 V,
* pfet Vth=-1.06 V, nfet_lvt Vth=0.42 V, pfet_lvt Vth=-0.45 V.
*
* Architecture (two independently-pinned gain nodes):
*   - LVT PMOS pair folded through NMOS cascodes.  The reference side
*     terminates in a PMOS current mirror whose OUTPUT is the TOP gain node
*     vpg (VDD-|Vsg| referenced, so it pins vpg about 0.55-0.7 V).  The
*     signal side cascode adds into vpg as well.
*   - LVT NMOS pair folded through PMOS cascodes.  The reference side
*     terminates in an NMOS current mirror whose OUTPUT is the BOTTOM gain
*     node vng (Vgs referenced, pins vng about 0.7 V).  The signal side
*     cascode adds into vng as well.
*   - Each gain node is terminated by a current mirror, so its quiescent
*     level is deterministic (no floating node).  The standard-Vt output
*     devices sit slightly on at quiescence (class-AB), and a positive
*     vinp step moves BOTH gates down: the PMOS output pushes up while the
*     NMOS output pulls back (coherent push-pull).
*   - Dual series-RC Miller compensation from vout to each gain node.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*=========================== Bias generation ===========================
* Reference diode: 20 uA flows into iref (from vdd) and out here to vss.
XNRF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* PMOS bias: NMOS mirror sinks the reference current, PMOS diode sets pbias.
XNBMP pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XPBD  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2

* NMOS cascode bias vnc (wide-swing with resistor level shift).
XBN1  nv1 nv1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
RNC1  nv1 vnc 18k
XBN2  vnc pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2

* PMOS cascode bias vpc (wide-swing with resistor level shift).
XBP1  nv2 nv2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
RPC1  nv2 vpc 24k
XBP2  vpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

*=========================== PMOS input path -> vpg =====================
* LVT PMOS pair.  MP_R (g=vinp) is the signal side, MP_L (g=vinn) the ref.
XPT  stp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMPL np1 vinn stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMPR np2 vinp stp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
* Fold current sources pull down from the P-pair drain nodes.
XNF1 np1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XNF2 np2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
* NMOS cascodes: ref side to vrp, signal side into the top gain node vpg.
XMC1 vrp vnc np1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XMC2 vpg vnc np2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
* PMOS mirror load: diode at vrp, mirror output pins vpg.
XDYP vrp vrp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMYP vpg vrp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2

*=========================== NMOS input path -> vng =====================
* LVT NMOS pair.  MN_L (g=vinp) is the signal side, MN_R (g=vinn) the ref.
XNT  stn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMNL nn1 vinp stn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMNR nn2 vinn stn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* Fold current sources push up into the N-pair drain nodes.
XPF1 nn1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XPF2 nn2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
* PMOS cascodes: signal side (nn1) into vng, ref side (nn2) to vrn.
XMC3 vng vpc nn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMC4 vrn vpc nn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
* NMOS mirror load: diode at vrn, mirror output pins vng.
XDYN vrn vrn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=2
XMYN vng vrn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=2

*=========================== Class-AB output stage ======================
XMNO vout vng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4
XMPO vout vpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4

*=========================== Miller compensation ========================
CC1 vout vgm1 3p
RC1 vgm1 vng  1.5k
CC2 vout vgm2 3p
RC2 vgm2 vpg  1.5k
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8V core models.  Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* Architecture:
*  - complementary NMOS/PMOS rail-to-rail input pairs (LVT devices)
*  - constant-gm tail current switch (diode-connected boost devices)
*  - folded-cascode current summing (single-ended, cascoded current mirrors)
*  - floating-current-source Class-AB output (high-impedance resistive battery)
*  - series-RC Miller compensation
*
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation from the 20uA reference (nbias = iref)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMB1  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=10
XMB2  pbias iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=10
XMB3  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=20
XMB4  ncas  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=20
XMB5  ncas  ncas  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=1.5
XMB6  pcas  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=10
XMB7  pcas  pcas  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=3

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Rail-to-rail input stage
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* N input pair (active near VDD)
XMN1  an1 vinn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=16 nf=4
XMN2  an2 vinp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=16 nf=4
XMNt  nt   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=24
XMNs  nt   nt   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12

* P input pair (active near VSS)
XMP1  ap1 vinn pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XMP2  ap2 vinp pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XMPt  pt   pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=48
XMPs  pt   pt    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=24

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded cascode current summing
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* N-pair folded UP through PMOS cascode, single-ended via cascoded NMOS mirror
XMFn1 an1  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40
XMFn2 an2  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40
XMCn1 nx   pcas  an1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XMCn2 sum  pcas  an2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XMRn1 nx   nx    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12
XMRn2 nm   nx    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12
XMRn2c sum ncas  nm  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12

* P-pair folded DOWN through NMOS cascode, single-ended via cascoded PMOS mirror
XMFp1 ap1  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=20
XMFp2 ap2  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=20
XMCp1 px   ncas  ap1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12
XMCp2 sum  ncas  ap2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12
XMRp1 px   px    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=16
XMRp2 pm   px    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=16
XMRp2c sum pcas  pm  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=16

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Class-AB output stage (floating current source, high-Z resistive battery)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMOUTN vout sum  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=80 nf=16
XMOUTP vout gp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=240 nf=40

* sum drives the NMOS gate directly; PMOS gate sits a battery above it.
* Resistor floating battery biased by XB1 (vdd->gp) and XB2 (sum->vss); long
* current sources keep the battery from loading the first-stage output.
XB1   gp  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4.0 w=32
RAB   gp  sum   100k

circuit:

* SKY130 1.8 V core devices. Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ================= Bias generation =================
* iref (20 uA) -> NMOS diode, gate = vbn (reuse iref node)
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
* mirror vbn into a PMOS reference diode -> vbp
XMNb1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMP0 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=1

* Cascode bias vbnc (NMOS cascode gate, level shifted up from vbn)
XMP_cb vbnc vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1
XMN_cb vbnc vbnc ncb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Rcbn ncb vss 15k
* Cascode bias vbpc (PMOS cascode gate, level shifted down from vbp)
XMN_cp vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
Rcbp vdd pcb 20k
XMP_cb2 vbpc vbpc pcb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1

* ================= Rail-to-rail complementary input =================
* N-channel pair (regular, tail to vss)
XMN1 dn1 vinp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMN2 dn2 vinn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMNt tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
* P-channel pair (lvt, tail to vdd; inputs swapped for inverting sum)
XMP1 dp1 vinp tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
XMP2 dp2 vinn tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
XMPt tailp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1

* ================= N-pair folded cascode (PMOS fold + PMOS cascode + NMOS cascode mirror) =================
XMPf1 dn1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1
XMPf2 dn2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1
XMPc1 v1 vbpc dn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1
XMPc2 na vbpc dn2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1
XMNld na na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNlm mn_src na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNlmc v1 vbnc mn_src vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ================= P-pair folded cascode (NMOS fold + NMOS cascode + PMOS cascode mirror) =================
XMNf1 dp1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XMNf2 dp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XMNc1 v1 vbnc dp1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XMNc2 pb vbnc dp2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XMPld pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1
XMPlm mp_src pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1
XMPlmc v1 vbpc mp_src vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11 nf=1

* ================= Floating-current-source Class-AB output (resistor battery) =================
XMPout vout v1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=64 nf=10
XMNout vout ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* FCS bias current sources (20 uA each, cascoded for high output impedance)
XMPfcs2 v1src vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=1
XMPfcsc v1 vbpc v1src vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=1
XMNfcs2 ngsrc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMNfcsc ng vbnc ngsrc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
* floating battery resistor: v1 - ng = 20u * 23k = 0.46 V
Rbat v1 ng 23k

* ================= Miller compensation (series RC) =================
Rz v1 cn 2k
Cc cn vout 15p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB opamp (SKY130, 1.8 V).
* Blocks: 20 uA-referenced bias, complementary input pairs with constant-gm
* current switches, complementary folded-cascode current summing (single-ended
* via NMOS mirror), cross-coupled floating-current-source Class-AB control,
* series-RC Miller compensation on both interstage gates.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------- Reference / bias ----------
* External 20 uA is sourced from VDD into iref: NMOS diode sinks it (nb0=iref).
XMND iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* Mirror 20 uA into a PMOS diode: pb0 = ndp.
XMNCP ndp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XMPD ndp ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
* PMOS cascode gate pcas = VDD - 2 Vsg.
XMPC1 z1 z1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMPC2 pcas pcas z1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMNS1 pcas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* NMOS cascode gate ncas = 2 Vgs.
XMNC1 y1 y1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XMNC2 ncas ncas y1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XMPS1 ncas ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
* ---------- Complementary input pairs ----------
* PMOS pair (sources pp), NMOS pair (sources np); drains share fold nodes d1/d2.
XMP1 d1 vinn pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMP2 d2 vinp pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMN1 d1 vinn np vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN2 d2 vinp np vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* Fixed 20 uA tails.
XMPTP pp ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMNTN np iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* ---------- Constant-gm current switches ----------
* NMOS activity detector: sense FET gate=vinp source=np, resistor pull-up.
XMDN dtn vinp np vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
RPDN dtn vdd 2meg
* Regenerating inverter drives PM switch gate swp.
XINVP1 swp dtn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XINVN1 swp dtn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XMPSW pp swp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
* PMOS activity detector: sense FET gate=vinp source=pp, pull-down.
XMDP dtp vinp pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
RPDP dtp vss 2meg
XINVP2 swn dtp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1
XINVN2 swn dtp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XMNSW np swn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* ---------- Folded-cascode current summing ----------
* PMOS fold sources 25 uA: vdd -> d1/d2.
XF1 d1 ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=5
XF2 d2 ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=5
* d1 -> diode NMOS DN1, mirrored by MN1M onto summing node vx.
XDN1 d1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XMN1M vx d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
* Fixed NMOS sink balancing the floating-source push at vx.
XNFX vx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* ---------- Class-AB output + floating current source ----------
XMPO vout vga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
XMNO vout vx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=5
* Cross-coupled floating current source between vga (upper) and vx (lower).
XMFP vga vx vfmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=4
XMFN vfmid vga vx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* Fixed PMOS source into vga balancing MPF at DC.
XPFX vga ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
* ---------- Series-RC Miller compensation ----------
RM1 vout zm1 600
CM1 zm1 vx 8p
RM2 vout zm2 600
CM2 zm2 vga 8p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB opamp (SKY130 1.8V core).
*
* Architecture:
*   - NMOS + PMOS complementary input pairs (L=0.15), rail-to-rail VCM range.
*   - Supply-referenced VCM sensing switches the pair tails: active pair 40 uA
*     alone; when both pairs are on each carries 20 uA (controls UGB spread).
*   - Folded cascodes sum both paths at z1/z2 with constant 10 uA standing
*     current in every input state.
*   - Common-source push-pull outputs (L=0.5); quiescent gates are set through
*     large resistors by matched diode references, ~200 uA quiescent current.
*   - Symmetric series-RC Miller compensation on both output gates.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Primary references (L=0.15): iref 20u NMOS diode; pbd 20u PMOS diode
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XNref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XNp   pbd  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XPd   pbd  pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8

* 40 uA PMOS / NMOS diode gates for the single-active-pair tail setting
XNpg40 pg40 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XPpg40 pg40 pg40 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XPng40 ng40 pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=16
XNng40 ng40 ng40 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8

* Cascode gates: two stacked 10u diodes (density 0.5 N / 0.25 P)
XPncb ncb pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XNcb1 ncb ncb  nm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNcb2 nm1 nm1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNpcb pcb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XPcb1 pcb pcb  pm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XPcb2 pm1 pm1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4

* Comparator references: 5u diodes, L=0.15 (track pair Vth across PVT)
XNpref pref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XPpref pref pref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XPnref nref pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNnref nref nref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

* Output-stage quiescent gate references: 10u diodes, L matched to outputs
XPqref gpref gpref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNqref gpref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XNqrefn gnref gnref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XPqrefn gnref pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Common-mode sense differential pairs compare vinp against references.
* PMOS sense: pdr low = enabled.  NMOS sense: ndr high = enabled.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XPst  pst  pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XPsi  pdi  vinp pst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XPsr  pdr  pref pst vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XNl1  pdi  pdi  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XNl2  pdr  pdi  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XIP1p enp  pdr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XIP1n enp  pdr  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIP2p enpb enp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XIP2n enpb enp  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XNst  nst  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XNsi  ndi  vinp nst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNsr  ndr  nref nst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XPl1  ndi  ndi  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XPl2  ndr  ndi  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XIN1p ennb ndr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XIN1n ennb ndr  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIN2p enn  ennb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XIN2n enn  ennb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Tail-gate selectors.  ptg: both->pbd(20u), P-only->pg40(40u), off->vdd.
* ntg: both->iref(20u), N-only->ng40(40u), off->vss.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTPB1 pbd  enn  ptmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTPB2 ptmp enp  ptg  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTPP1 pg40 ennb ptg2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTPP2 ptg2 enp  ptg  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTPU  ptg  enp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

XTNB1 iref enn  ntmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTNB2 ntmp enp  ntg  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTNP1 ng40 enn  ntg2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTNP2 ntg2 enpb ntg  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTND  ntg  ennb vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Complementary input pairs and tails
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XPt   sp   ptg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XNt   sn   ntg  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XP1   a1   vinn sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XP2   a2   vinp sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XN1   b1   vinn sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XN2   b2   vinp sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4

* Constant fold sources (10u) and switched extras (half of active tail)
XPf1  a1   pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XPf2  a2   pbd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XNf1  b1   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNf2  b2   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XPe1  a1   ptg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XPe2  a2   ptg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XNe1  b1   ntg  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNe2  b2   ntg  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2

* Folding cascodes
XNc1  a1   ncb  z1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XNc2  a2   ncb  z2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2

XPc2  b2   pcb  z2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Push-pull class-AB output; quiescent gates pulled to matched references
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XPout vout z1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=5
XNout vout z2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=5
RGP   z1   gpref 50meg
RGN   z2   gnref 50meg

* Symmetric series-RC Miller compensation
RZP   vout rc1  300
CCP   rc1  z1   5p
RZN   vout rc2  300
CCN   rc2  z2   5p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* Stages:
*   - complementary NMOS/PMOS rail-to-rail input pairs
*   - current-summing folded-cascode gain stage (single-ended take-off)
*   - translinear Class-AB output with floating bias stack
*   - series-RC Miller compensation
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation.  External 20 uA reference is sunk by a diode NMOS at iref.
*
* NMOS diode reference (20 uA): iref = one NMOS Vgs above vss
XNIR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8
*
* PMOS bias stack: vdd -|Vgs|- pp1 -|Vgs|- pp2, pulled down by 20 uA NMOS
XPB1 pp1 pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
XPB2 pp2 pp2 pp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
XNB0 pp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8
*
* NMOS cascode bias: vdd->20u PMOS->nn1 -Vgs- nnx -Vgs- vss (bottom gate iref)
XPB0 nn1 pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
XNB1 nn1 nn1 nnx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8
XNB2 nnx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Rail-to-rail input pairs and tail sources (20 uA tails, 10 uA per input FET)
* PMOS input pair
XMP5 sp pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
XMP1 pa vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=2
XMP2 vg vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=30 nf=2
* NMOS input pair
XMN5 sn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8
XMN1 vg vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
XMN2 nb vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded cascode branches.
* P-input path: top PMOS stack 10 uA in, bottom NMOS stack 20 uA out.
*   balance: 10 (top) + 10 (input FET) = 20 (bottom)
* Side A (unused sense branch)
XMPTA pta pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=15
XMPBA pa pp2 pta vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=15
XMNTA pa nn1 pna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
XMNBA pna iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
* Side B (drain = vg, output sense)
XMPTB ptb pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=15
XMPBB vg pp2 ptb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=15
XMNTB vg nn1 pnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
XMNBB pnb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
*
* N-input path: top PMOS stack 30 uA in, bottom NMOS stack 20 uA out.
*   balance: 30 (top) = 10 (input FET) + 20 (bottom)
* Side A (drain = vg, output sense)
XMNTA2 nta pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=3
XMNBA2 vg pp2 nta vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=3
XMNTC2 vg nn1 nna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
XMNBBC2 nna iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
* Side B (unused sense branch)
XMNTB2 ntb pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=3
XMNBB2 nb pp2 ntb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=45 nf=3
XMNTCB nb nn1 nnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
XMNBBCB nnb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=12
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Class-AB output stage with floating translinear bias stack.
* GP pulled down by diode PMOS to vg; vg pulled down by diode NMOS to GN.
* Small 5 uA sources set the diode-stack current; output FETs are 20:1 copies
* -> ~100 uA quiescent output current.
XGPD gp pp1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5
XGND gn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMPD vg vg gp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
XMND vg vg gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XMPOUT vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XMNOUT vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series-RC Miller compensation, gain node to output.
CC1 vout nrc 1.5p
RZ1 nrc vg 300
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
*   Rail-to-rail complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs (constant-gm tail steering)
*   -> folded-cascode current-summing gain stage (single-ended node DRV)
*   -> Monticelli floating-current-source Class-AB push-pull output.
*   Series-RC Miller compensation from vout to each output gate.
* SKY130 1.8V core devices; l,w in micrometres (scale=1u).
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*====================== BIAS GENERATION =====================================
* iref port has 20u pumped in from vdd (external source vdd->iref).
* NMOS reference diode -> NB
XNREF  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=2
* PMOS reference: diode PMOS in series with an NMOS copy carrying 20u -> PB
XPNC   pbref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=2
XPREF  vdd pbref pbref vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=2
* NMOS cascode-gate bias NC: vdd->PMOScs->diodeN->NMOScs->vss
XBNCP  vdd pbnc ncb_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=2
XBNCD  ncb_n ncb_n ncb_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=2
XBNCS  ncb_s iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=2
* PMOS cascode-gate bias PC: vdd->PMOScs->diodeP->NMOScs->vss
XBPCP  vdd pbnc pcb_s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=2
XBPCD  pcb_s pcb_n pcb_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=2
XBPCN  pcb_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=2
*====================== INPUT STAGE =========================================
* Tail current sources (constant-gm: full current; pairs cross at rails).
* N-pair tail (NMOS to vss)
XNT    ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
* P-pair tail (PMOS to vdd)
XPT    vdd pbnc ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=4
* NMOS differential pair (drains to fold nodes f1/f2)
XMN1   f1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XMN2   f2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
* PMOS differential pair (drains to fold nodes f1/f2)
XMP1   f1 vinn ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XMP2   f2 vinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* Fold branches: each fold node sees a PMOS cascode source (from vdd) and an
* NMOS cascode sink (to vss).  Bottom NMOS sinks form the current mirror that
* converts differential to single-ended at DRV (diode on f2 side).
* PMOS fold current sources + cascodes (source fold current into f1/f2)
XPF1T  vdd pbnc pf1t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XPF1C  pf1t pcb_n f1   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
XPF2T  vdd pbnc pf2t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XPF2C  pf2t pcb_n f2   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
* NMOS fold cascodes (sink from f1/f2 down to mirror nodes m1/m2)
XNF1C  f1 ncb_n m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XNF2C  f2 ncb_n m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
* NMOS current mirror m1/m2 (diode on m2), output single-ended at m1=DRV
XNM2   m2 m2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
XNM1   m1 m2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
*====================== CLASS-AB OUTPUT (Monticelli floating sources) ========
* Output transistors
XMOUTN vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XMOUTP vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=10
* Floating NMOS (source=gn, gate=DRV=m1, drain=dn): drives NMOS output gate
XFLN   dn drv gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=3
* Floating PMOS (source=gp, gate=DRV=m1, drain=dp): drives PMOS output gate
XFLP   gp drv dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
* Diode/reference nodes dn (low) and dp (high), biased by fixed current sources
* dn: pulled up by PMOS cascode current source from vdd; diode NMOS to vss
XDNP   vdd pbnc dnt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=3
XDNC   dnt pcb_n dn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=3
XDND   dn dn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=3
* dp: pulled down by NMOS cascode current source to vss; diode PMOS to vdd
XDPP   dp dp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XDPN   dp2 ncb_n dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=3
XDPT   dp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=3
*====================== MILLER COMPENSATION (series RC) ======================
RCCP   gp  ccp vout 500
CCP    ccp vout 1.2p
RCCN   gn  ccn vout 500
CCN    ccn vout 1.2p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
*  Stage 1: complementary LVT input pairs (rail-to-rail common mode), each
*           driving a folded-cascode OTA with a cascode current-mirror load;
*           the two single-ended OTA outputs are tied (current summed) at z.
*  Stage 2: floating source-follower level shifters drive a rail-to-rail
*           common-source inverter pair (Class-AB output gain stage).
*  Comp:    series-RC Miller from vout back to z.
*  Bias:    all currents mirrored from the 20 uA iref port.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ==========================================================================
* Bias references
*   gns = iref (NMOS diode gate), gps = px (PMOS diode gate)
*   gnc = NMOS cascode gate (~vss+2Vgs), gpc = PMOS cascode gate (~vdd-2|Vgs|)
* ==========================================================================
Xrefn iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xmrn  px   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xrefp px   px   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
* gnc stack: pmos cs (20u) feeds two series diode nmos
Xncu  gnc  px   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xna   gnc  gnc  na   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xnb   na   na   vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
* gpc stack: two series diode pmos feed nmos cs (20u)
Xpa   pb1  pb1  vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xpb   gpc  gpc  pb1  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xpcn  gpc  iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4

* ==========================================================================
* Complementary input tails (constant current; rail-to-rail via pairs)
* ==========================================================================
Xnt   ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
Xpt   ptail px   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4

* ==========================================================================
* NMOS-input folded-cascode OTA.  Output = on2.
*   inputs nfet_lvt (drain a), pmos fold sources vdd->a, pmos cascodes a->on,
*   nmos cascode current-mirror load on->vss.
* ==========================================================================
Xni1  a1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12 nf=4
Xni2  a2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12 nf=4
Xnf1  a1 px  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=28 nf=4
Xnf2  a2 px  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=28 nf=4
Xnc1  on1 gpc a1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Xnc2  on2 gpc a2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* nmos cascode mirror (diode side on1)
Xl1b  s1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xl1t  on1 on1  s1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4
Xl2b  s2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xl2t  on2 on1  s2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=4

* ==========================================================================
* PMOS-input folded-cascode OTA.  Output = op2.
*   inputs pfet_lvt (drain b), nmos fold sinks b->vss, nmos cascodes op->b,
*   pmos cascode current-mirror load vdd->op.
* ==========================================================================
Xpi1  b1 vinn ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=4
Xpi2  b2 vinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=4
Xpf1  b1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=4
Xpf2  b2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=4
Xpc1  op1 gnc b1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=4
Xpc2  op2 gnc b2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=4
* pmos cascode mirror (diode side op1)
Xt1b  t1  px  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xt1t  op1 op1 t1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
Xt2b  t2  px  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xt2t  op2 op1 t2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

* current-sum tie
Rz on2 op2 1

* ==========================================================================
* Class-AB output stage.
*   gn = N-output gate (high), gp = P-output gate (low); both track z.
*   pmos source follower shifts z UP to gn ; nmos source follower shifts z DOWN
*   to gp.  Fixed gate-gap keeps both output devices conducting (Class AB).
* ==========================================================================
Xpdrv vss on2 gn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xpld  gn  gpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xndrv vdd op2 gp  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
Xnld  gp  gnc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=4
* rail-to-rail common-source output
Xon   vout gn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=20
Xop   vout gp  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=20

* ==========================================================================
* Series-RC Miller compensation (vout back to the summed high-Z node)
* ==========================================================================
Ccm   on2 vcmp 2.2p
Rcm   vcmp vout 300

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* SKY130 1.8V core devices. 20u reference current injected into iref.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: 20u into iref. Diode NMOS -> vbn=iref. Mirror -> vbp.
* Wide-swing cascode biases vbcasn / vbcasp.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XMnbias  iref   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMnmp    pbias  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMpbias  pbias  pbias  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XMncs1   cna    iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMncs2   vbcasn vbcasn cna    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5

XMpcs1   cpa    pbias  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMpcs2   vbcasp vbcasp cpa    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Rail-to-rail input: PMOS pair (low CM) + NMOS pair (high CM)
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XMp1     fp1    vinp   ptail  vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=8
XMp2     fp2    vinn   ptail  vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=8
XMptail  ptail  pbias  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XMn1     fn1    vinp   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMn2     fn2    vinn   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMntail  ntail  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded-cascode summing at high-Z node vh.
* PMOS pair -> NMOS cascode + PMOS mirror; NMOS pair -> PMOS cascode
* + NMOS mirror. Both summed at vh (vh falls for vinp rising).
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XMnfd1   fp1    iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMnfd2   fp2    iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMnc1    va1    vbcasn fp1    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
XMnc2    vh     vbcasn fp2    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
XMpm1    va1    va1    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMpm2    vh     va1    vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XMpfd1   fn1    pbias  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMpfd2   fn2    pbias  vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMpc1    vh     vbcasp fn1    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMpc2    vb1    vbcasp fn2    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMnm1    vb1    vb1    vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4
XMnm2    vh     vb1    vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Class-AB output stage with floating current source.
* vh drives PMOS output gate directly; floating current source
* (Mfcp/Mfcn) sets gn = vh - V_AB and the output quiescent current.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
XMpout   vout   vh     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=32
XMnout   vout   gn     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=16
XMfcp    vh     vbcasp mf     vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMfcn    mf     vbcasn gn     vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4

*------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series-RC Miller compensation: vout -> vh
*------------------------------------------------------------------
Cc      vout   mc     3p
Rz      mc     vh     2k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Rail-to-rail input: a PMOS-input current-mirror OTA (active at low VCM) and an
* NMOS-input current-mirror OTA (active at high VCM) share the inputs and tie
* their high-impedance outputs at node x; their transconductances add. The folded
* cascode-like stacking is provided by long-L mirror devices. A floating-class-AB
* push-pull output follows, with series-RC Miller compensation.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Bias generation (mirrored from the 20 uA iref port) ----
XMRN  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMBN1 pbr  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMRP  pbr  pbr vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* ============ PMOS-input OTA (active at LOW VCM), output at x ============
XPPT  pptail pbr  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XPP1  x   vinp pptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XPP2  pd  vinn pptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* NMOS current-mirror load: diode on pd (vinp side = non-inverting), output to x.
XPNM1 pd pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2
XPNM2 x  pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2

* ============ NMOS-input OTA (active at HIGH VCM), output at x ===========
XNNT  nntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XNN1  x   vinp nntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XNN2  nd  vinn nntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS current-mirror load: diode on nd (vinp side = non-inverting), output to x.
XNPM1 nd nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=4
XNPM2 x  nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=4

* ---- Floating-current-source Class-AB output ----
* NMOS driver gate is x; PMOS driver gate gp sits ~0.1 V ABOVE x (the PMOS has a
* larger |Vth|, so it still conducts). A small PMOS source feeds gp; the current
* flows through R_AB into x, setting gp-x = Ib*R_AB (a fixed "floating battery").
* Gates draw no AC current, so gp tracks x for signal while both drivers idle on.
XIBGP gp pbr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
RAB   gp x   20k
XMNO  vout x  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=160 nf=20
XMPO  vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=460 nf=40

* ---- Series-RC Miller compensation ----
RCZ vout cmid 350
CC  cmid x    6.0p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode operational amplifier.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout  (iref = 20 uA reference current into the pin)
* Stage 1: complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs, folded-cascode current summing.
* Stage 2: common-source output with active load (Miller-compensated).
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias references + cascode bias voltages
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference (iref sinks 20 uA); PMOS reference rail npsrc
XNR  iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XNS1 npsrc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XPR  npsrc npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* vbn_cas = Vthn + 2*Vovn  (cascoded-mirror reference, tracks Vthn)
Xbn_sn vbn_cas npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xbn_sc vbn_cas vbn_cas nbx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xbn_sp nbx     iref    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* vbp_cas = vdd - Vthp - 2*Vovp
Xbp_sp pbx     npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xbp_sc vbp_cas vbp_cas pbx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xbp_sn vbp_cas iref    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Complementary input pairs + folded-cascode summing at node n1
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Xnt n_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xpt p_tail npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* NMOS input pair : side1=vinn(diode), side2=vinp(output)
Xn_in1 fxn1 vinn n_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xn_in2 fxn2 vinp n_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* PMOS input pair : side1=vinp(diode), side2=vinn(output)
Xp_in1 fxp1 vinp p_tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
Xp_in2 fxp2 vinn p_tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8

*--- NMOS-input folded cascode (PMOS fold + PMOS cascode + cascoded NMOS mirror) ---
Xfp1 fxn1 npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xfp2 fxn2 npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xcpn1 nm1 fxn1 vbp_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xcpn2 n1  fxn2 vbp_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xlc1 nm1 m1a vbn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xln1 m1a m1a vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xlc2 n1  m2a vbn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xln2 m2a m1a vss     vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

*--- PMOS-input folded cascode (NMOS fold + NMOS cascode + cascoded PMOS mirror) ---
Xfn1 fxp1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xfn2 fxp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xcnp1 np1 fxp1 vbn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xcnp2 n1  fxp2 vbn_cas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
Xpc1 np1 p1a vbp_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xlp1 p1a p1a vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xpc2 n1  p2a vbp_cas vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
Xlp2 p2a p1a vdd      vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: common-source NMOS output + PMOS active-load current source
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Xon   vout n1    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=32
Xpld  vout npsrc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=60  nf=10

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Series-RC Miller compensation  (vout -> Rz -> nCc -> Cc -> n1)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Rz vout nCc 2k
Cc nCc n1 1p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier.
* Stage1: complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs with current-mirror loads (single-ended sum at v1).
* Stage2: class-AB push-pull common-source output, floating-battery bias (Rab + sink).
* Miller series-RC compensation. 1.8 V SKY130 core devices. Ideal R/C permitted.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*==================== BIAS (current-mirror from 20u reference) ====================
Xmnb    iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2
Xmnbp   pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2
Xmpb    pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2

*==================== STAGE 1: complementary input pairs -> mirror loads -> v1 ====================
*--- NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load (output at v1) ---
Xmntail sn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=2
Xmn1    d1  vinn sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.5
Xmn2    v1  vinp sn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.5
Xmpm1   d1  d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2
Xmpm2   v1  d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=2

*--- PMOS input pair, NMOS mirror load (output at v1) ---
Xmptail sp  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=2
Xmp1    e1  vinn sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.5
Xmp2    v1  vinp sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.5
Xmnm1   e1  e1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2
Xmnm2   v1  e1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=2

*==================== STAGE 2: class-AB push-pull output ====================
* gp = v1, gn floats to v1 - (Ibias*Rab) so Vsg(Mop)+Vgs(Mon) is constant.
Xmop    vout v1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5
Xmon    vout gn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5
Rab     v1   gn  200k
Xmibn   gn   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=2

*==================== MILLER COMPENSATION (series R-C) ====================
Cc      vout vmc 30p
Rc      vmc v1   2k

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier (SKY130 1.8V)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: IREF -> PMOS diode (pb) -> NMOS diode (nb)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------- bias chain ----------
XM_PDIODE pb iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=2
XM_PB2NB nb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=2
XM_NDIODE nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=2
* keep-alive bleeder so unused branch nodes have a defined dc path
RBLEED_P sp vss 50meg
RBLEED_N sn vdd 50meg

* ---------- NMOS input half (active at high VCM) ----------
*  tail  : PMOS from vdd to sn   (20uA scaled)
*  pair  : M1n (gate vinp) -> an ,  M2n (gate vinn) -> snode
*  mirror: P1n diode at an -> P2n into snode
XM_TAILN sn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_M1N an vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_M2N snode vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_P1N an an vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_P2N snode an vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4

* ---------- PMOS input half (active at low VCM) ----------
*  tail  : NMOS from sp to vss
*  pair  : M1p (gate vinp) -> bp ,  M2p (gate vinn) -> ep
*  mirror: N1p diode at bp -> N2p (2x) pulls from snode
*          N3p diode at ep absorbs the other half
XM_TAILP sp nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_M1P bp vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_M2P ep vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_N1P bp bp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
XM_N2P snode bp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=4
XM_N3P ep ep vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4
* dc balance current at snode = I_tp
XM_BALS snode pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4

* ---------- second stage : common source + current sink load ----------
* snode sits high (vdd - Vsg) so the second stage is a PMOS CS device
XM_OUP vout snode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
XM_OUN vout nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=4

* ---------- miller compensation ----------
CMILLER vout snode 3p
RMILLER snode vout 470
