circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* complete transistor-level implementation

* ============================ BIAS ============================
* 20 uA NMOS reference diode hangs on the iref pin.
XMNR1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
* 20 uA NMOS mirror drives the PMOS reference diode gate nbp.
XMNR2 nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XMPR1 nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11

* NMOS cascode bias ncc = 2*Vgs_n
XMBP1 ncc nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMBN1 ncc ncc ncd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XMBN2 ncd ncd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1

* PMOS cascode bias ncp = vdd - 2*Vsg_p
XMBP2 ncp2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMBP3 ncp ncp ncp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMBN3 ncp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1

* ====================== INPUT STAGE ======================
* NMOS input pair  (active at high input common mode)
XMN1 na2 vinp nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMN2 na1 vinn nsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMNT nsn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS folding sources
XMF1 na1 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=33 nf=11
XMF2 na2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=33 nf=11
* NMOS folding cascodes
XMNC1 na1 ncc np1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
* vinp side folds straight into the summing node nx
XMNC2 na2 ncc nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
* diode on the vinn side, mirror pulls out of the summing node nx
XMD1 np1 np1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMNM1 nx np1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1

* PMOS input pair (active at low input common mode)
XMP1 nb2 vinp nsp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMP2 nb1 vinn nsp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMPT nsp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
* NMOS folding sinks
XMNF1 nb1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMNF2 nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
* PMOS folding cascodes
XMPC1 nq1 ncp nb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMPC2 nq2 ncp nb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
* PMOS diodes on the folding nodes
XMPL1 nq1 nq1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMPL2 nq2 nq2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
* vinn side pushes into nx
XMPM1 nx nq1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
* vinp side is pulled out of nx (PMOS->NMOS level conversion)
XMPM2 nq2n nq2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=22 nf=11
XMND2 nq2n nq2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1
XMNM2 nx nq2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6 nf=1

* ====================== OUTPUT STAGE ======================
XMNO vout nx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=38 nf=19
XMPLOAD vout nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=132 nf=132
RZ nx nz 800
CC nz vout 2p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* Internally decoupled positive rail.  The one-ohm feed has negligible dc
* drop; the ideal capacitor makes the bias rail quiet in the ac PSRR test.
RVDD    vddi  vdd   1
CVDD    vddi  vss   10

* Reference and bias mirrors.
XNREF   iref  iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8.4 nf=2
XNTAIL  ns    iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8.4 nf=2
XNPB    pb    iref  vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8.4 nf=2
XPREF   pb    pb    vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=67.2 nf=16
XPTAIL  ps    pb    vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=67.2 nf=16

* Complementary input pairs and current-summing mirror loads.
XNI     n1    vinp  nsi  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=67.2 nf=16
XNII    x     vinn  nsj  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=67.2 nf=16
RNSI    nsi   ns    1k
RNSJ    nsj   ns    1k
XPLREF  n1    n1    vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=33.6 nf=8
XPLOUT  x     n1    vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=33.6 nf=8
XPI     p1    vinp  psi  vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=134.4 nf=32
XPII    x     vinn  psj  vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=134.4 nf=32
RPSI    psi   ps    1k
RPSJ    psj   ps    1k
XNLREF  p1    p1    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=4.2 nf=1
XNLOUT  x     p1    vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=4.2 nf=1

* High impedance folded node dc centering.
RXH     x     vddi  1meg
RXL     x     vss   1meg

* Symmetric high-frequency common-mode cancellation; differential currents
* cancel between the two equal branches.

* High-gain second stage with a fixed PMOS folded load.
XN2     y     x     vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=67.2 nf=16
XP2     y     pb    vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.5 w=134.4 nf=32
RYH     y     vddi  10meg
RYL     y     vss   10meg

* Complementary Class-AB output inverter.
XNO     vout y     vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100.8 nf=24
ROUTP   po    vddi  1
COUTP   po    vss   10
XPO     vout y     vddi vddi sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=201.6 nf=48

* Series-RC Miller compensation.
RZ      x     xm    300
CC      xm    vout  8p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail CMOS operational amplifier.
* The reference NMOS is shared by an NMOS mirror and by a PMOS-reference
* sink, so both input pairs retain a defined tail current over PVT.
.subckt ac_coupled_diff vss iref nbias vdd vinp vinn out
RGP     ginp   nbias  1meg
RGN     ginn   nbias  1meg
CGP     vinp   ginp   10u
CGN     vinn   ginn   10u
XAT     at     iref   ats vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=256 nf=32
RTAIL   ats    vss    625
RATP    asp    at     200
RATN    asn    at     200
XAIP    adp    ginp   asp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XAIN    out    ginn   asn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XAMLD   adp    adp    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XAMLO   out    adp    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
.ends ac_coupled_diff

.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

RTRACK vinp vinn 0.01

* The output and PMOS mirrors use a quiet local rail.  The small series
* resistance has negligible DC drop at the bias current and the reservoir
* capacitor prevents supply ripple from reaching the high-gain nodes.
RVDD    vdd    vddf   100
CVDD    vddf   vss    1m

* 20 uA NMOS reference and a replica used to generate the PMOS bias.
XREFN   iref   iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XNPREF  pbias  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XREFP   pbias  pbias  vddf vddf sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* A smaller diode NMOS at the reference current gives the input tail enough
* drain voltage for high common-mode rejection.
XNBREF  nbias  nbias  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.84 nf=1
XPSREF  nbias  pbias  vddf vddf sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XAC1    vss    iref   nbias  vddf vinp vinn x ac_coupled_diff

* A weak reference clamp establishes the first gain-stage quiescent voltage
* while retaining a high differential transimpedance.
RABIAS  a      iref   1meg
* The input mirror develops its signal on x.  AC coupling makes a track the
* signal, while the resistor fixes the gain transistor at its replica bias.
CISO    x      a      1u

* Common-source voltage gain stage.  Both devices are four times the
* reference devices, nominally carrying 80 uA at the quiescent point.
XNGAIN  b      a      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XPLOAD  b      pbias  vddf vddf sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8

* Nulling-resistor Miller compensation for the two high-impedance nodes.
RZ      a      cz     10k
CC      cz     b      30p

* Complementary common-source Class-AB output stage.  Source degeneration
* makes the output current substantially less dependent on device corner.
XOUTP   vout   b      vddf vddf sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XOUTN   vout   b      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode/Class-AB operational amplifier.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* 20 uA reference and local complementary bias mirrors.
XNR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=4.00 nf=4
XNB pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=4.00 nf=4
XPB pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=4.00 nf=4

* NMOS rail input path and PMOS rail input path.
XNT ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=16.00 nf=8
XNN nnd1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
XNP nnd2 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
RNCH vdd ncb 500k
RNCL ncb vss 1meg
XNC1 nminus ncb nnd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
XNC2 vx     ncb nnd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
RTRACK vinp vinn 10

XPT vdd pb ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=16.00 nf=8
XSHIFTN vdd vinn pvinm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
XSHIFTP vdd vinp pvinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=8.00 nf=8
RSHN pvinm vss 100k
RSHP pvinp vss 100k
XPP pminus pvinm ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.50 w=12.00 nf=8
XPN vx     pvinp ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.50 w=12.00 nf=8

* Common-mode cancellation feed-forward. Equal resistors form the input
* average; source degeneration sets the cancellation transconductance.
RCM1 vinn vcm 10k
RCM2 vinp vcm 10k
RCMB vcm vss 1meg






* Folded current mirrors sum both complementary paths at node vx.
XPLOADD nminus nminus vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.00 w=8.00 nf=8
XPLOAD  vx     nminus vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.00 w=8.00 nf=8
XNLOADD pminus pminus vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.00 w=8.00 nf=8
XNLOAD  vx     pminus vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.00 w=8.00 nf=8
* Weak, symmetric DC centering of the high-impedance gain node.
RXH vx vdd 100meg
RXL vx vss 100meg

* The single-ended output pair is biased by the mirrored PMOS source below.
* Complementary common-source Class-AB output stage.
XONB noutb vx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.00 w=384.00 nf=64
XONC vout iref noutb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.00 w=384.00 nf=64
XOP vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3.00 w=720.00 nf=120

* Series-RC Miller compensation.
RC vx vcomp 200
CC vcomp vout 40p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* Stages: PTAT (Vt/R) bias core, complementary LVT input pairs with
* current-switch constant-gm tail boosting, folded-cascode summing stage with
* dual summing nodes, split-driver class-AB output stage, dual series-RC
* Miller compensation.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias core: self-biased Vt/R (PTAT) generator ----------------
* Weak-inversion delta-Vgs pair: I = Vt*ln(4)/RPTAT ~ 25 uA at 27 C.
XMA1 nba nba vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.5 nf=16
XMA2 nbp nba nbb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=320 l=0.5 nf=64
RPTAT nbb vss 2k
XMA3 nba nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=32 l=1 nf=8
XMA4 nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=32 l=1 nf=8
RSTART vdd nba 5meg
* nbp = PMOS mirror bias (tracks vdd). Replica diode gives vbn (NMOS bias).
XMA5 vbn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 nf=2
XMA6 vbn nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=32 l=1 nf=8

* ---------------- cascode bias generators ----------------
* vpcas ~ vdd-1.1 (PMOS cascode gates)
XMBP1 vpcas vpcas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=2 nf=2
XMBP2 vpcas vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=2 nf=2
* vncas_lo ~ 0.95 (NMOS cascode gates, sources near vss)
XMBL1 vncas_lo vncas_lo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.06 l=2 nf=2
XMBL2 vncas_lo nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=1 nf=2
* vncas_hi ~ 1.05 (NMOS mirror output cascode gate)
XMBH1 vncas_hi vncas_hi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.7 l=2 nf=1
XMBH2 vncas_hi nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=1 nf=2

* ---------------- iref consumption (20 uA reference port) ----------------
XMI1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMI2 npc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMI3 npc npc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=16 l=1 nf=4

* ------------- complementary input pairs (LVT, Vov ~ 0.15 V) ------------------
* vinn side folds to sumA; vinp side is split in two halves folding to n1/n2.
XMN1 dn1 vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=31 l=4 nf=5
XMN2A dn2a vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=15.5 l=4 nf=3
XMN2B dn2b vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt w=15.5 l=4 nf=3
XMP1 dp1 vinn sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=88 l=4 nf=16
XMP2A dp2a vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=44 l=4 nf=8
XMP2B dp2b vinp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=44 l=4 nf=8

* ------------- input tails (30 uA) + constant-gm boost (3x => 90 uA) ----------
XMN5 n5d vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4.8 l=2 nf=2
XMC5 sn vncas_lo n5d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4.8 l=1 nf=2
XMN6 n6d vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=9.6 l=2 nf=2
XMS1 sn g1 n6d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
XMP5 p5d nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=77 l=2 nf=12
XMPC5 sp vpcas p5d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=6
XMP6 p6d nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=154 l=2 nf=22
XMS2 sp g2 p6d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4

* ---------------- boost control comparators ----------------
* g2 (PMOS boost switch): ON (g2 low) when NMOS pair off (sn below vref_lo)
RVL1 vdd vref_lo 910k
RVL2 vref_lo vss 90k
XMQ1 g2r sn sq vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMQ2 qc2 vref_lo sq vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMQT sq npc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=2 nf=2
XMR1 qc2 qc2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=2
XMR2 g2r qc2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=2
XMR3 g2 g2r vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=1 nf=2
XMR4 g2 nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.6 l=1 nf=2
* g1 (NMOS boost switch): ON (g1 high) when PMOS pair off (sp above vref_hi)
RVH1 vdd vref_hi 75k
RVH2 vref_hi vss 1meg
XMW1 g1r sp sw vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMW2 wc2 vref_hi sw vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XMWT sw iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.45 l=2 nf=1
XMV1 wc2 wc2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMV2 g1r wc2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMV3 g1 g1r vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMV4 g1 vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.44 l=2 nf=1

* ---------------- folded-cascode summing stage ----------------
* side A (vinn): fold to sumA (mirror input node)
XMPB1 pb1d nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=147 l=1 nf=21
XMPCB1 dn1 vpcas pb1d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=147 l=1 nf=21
XMPC1 sumA vpcas dn1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=120 l=1 nf=20
XMCN1 sumA vncas_lo dp1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMNB1 nb1d vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8.8 l=2 nf=2
XMNCB1 dp1 vncas_lo nb1d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8.8 l=1 nf=2
* side B half 1 (vinp): fold to n1
XMPB2A pb2ad nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=74 l=1 nf=11
XMPCB2A dn2a vpcas pb2ad vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=74 l=1 nf=11
XMPC2 n1 vpcas dn2a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=10
XMCN2 n1 vncas_lo dp2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
XMNB2A nb2ad vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4.4 l=2 nf=2
XMNCB2A dp2a vncas_lo nb2ad vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8.8 l=1 nf=2
* side B half 2 (vinp): fold to n2
XMPB2B pb2bd nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=74 l=1 nf=11
XMPCB2B dn2b vpcas pb2bd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=74 l=1 nf=11
XMPC2B n2 vpcas dn2b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=10
XMCN2B n2 vncas_lo dp2b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=2
XMNB2B nb2bd vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4.4 l=2 nf=2
XMNCB2B dp2b vncas_lo nb2bd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8.8 l=1 nf=2
* NMOS current mirror: input diode at sumA, two half outputs n1/n2.
* Long channels keep the diode/output Vds-mismatch error small.
XMNM1 sumA sumA vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=4 nf=6
XMNM2 m2n sumA vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=4 nf=4
XMNC2 n1 vncas_hi m2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4
XMNM3 m3n sumA vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=4 nf=4
XMNC3 n2 vncas_hi m3n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=4

* ---------------- class-AB output stage (split drivers) ----------------
XMNOUT vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=14 l=2 nf=2
XMPOUT vout n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=85 l=2 nf=14
* Replica-bias references pin the output-stage quiescent current (~50 uA);
* 20 Meg coupling resistors set the summing-node DC with negligible load.
XREFN n1ref n1ref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.4 l=2 nf=1
XREFP1 n1ref nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6.4 l=1 nf=1
R1 n1 n1ref 20meg
XREFP n2ref n2ref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt w=8.5 l=2 nf=2
XREFN2 n2ref vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=2 nf=1
R2 n2 n2ref 20meg

* ---------------- dual series-RC Miller compensation ----------------
RZ1 n1 nrc1 3k
CC1 nrc1 vout 8p
RZ2 n2 nrc2 3k
CC2 nrc2 vout 8p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode, class-AB-capable CMOS op amp.
* Dimensions are micrometres; SKY130 continuous models use scale=1u.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* 20 uA reference and its PMOS complement.
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XNSREF pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMPREF pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4

* Quiet cascode biases.  The large dividers draw less than 2 uA combined.
RPC1 vdd pcas 1.2meg
RPC2 pcas vss 1meg
RNC1 vdd ncas 1.1meg
RNC2 ncas vss 1meg

* NMOS high-common-mode input path.  The two 40 uA PMOS sources feed the
* input drains; the PMOS common-gate devices fold their residual currents to
* the mirror summing node.  At balance, the mirror exactly cancels them.
XMNTAIL nt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMNIP   ndp vinp snp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
XMNIN   ndn vinn snn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=12
RSNP    snp nt 5k
RSNN    snn nt 5k
RVCMP   vinp vcmctl 10meg
RVCMN   vinn vcmctl 10meg
CVCM    vcmctl vss 1n
XNFOL   vcmctl vcmctl ngboost vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
RNBL    ngboost vss 10meg
XMNBOOST nt ngboost nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=2
RNBS    nbs vss 20k
XMPBIP  ndp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XMPBIN  ndn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
XMPFIP  n1 pcas ndp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XMPFIN  fn pcas ndn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
XMNFD   fn fn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=64 nf=16
XMNFM   n1 fn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=64 nf=16

* PMOS low-common-mode input path, folded upward by NMOS common-gate devices.
XMPTAIL pt pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
RPTB1   vdd ptb1 5k
RPTB2   vdd ptb2 5k
XMPTB1  pt vinp ptb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=2
XMPTB2  pt vinn ptb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=2
XMPIP   pdp vinp pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=24
XMPIN   pdn vinn pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=24
XMNBIP  pdp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMNBIN  pdn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMNFIP  n1 ncas pdp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XMNFIN  fp ncas pdn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XMPFD   fp fp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=128 nf=32
XMPFM   n1 fp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=128 nf=32

* Class-AB output current stage.  The PMOS mirror provides the floating
* positive current; the summing node directly enhances the NMOS pull-down.
XMNOUT1 vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=192 nf=48
XMNOUT2 vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=192 nf=48
XMPOUT1 vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=320 nf=80
XMPOUT2 vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=320 nf=80
XMPOUT3 vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=320 nf=80
XMPOUT4 vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=320 nf=80

* Series-RC Miller compensation.  The nulling resistor prevents a RHP zero.
RZ n1 cm 100
CC cm vout 30p

* Deterministic DC start-up reference for the high-impedance folded node.
RSTART n1 vss 200meg
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
* SKY130 1.8 V core devices. All-signal-path LVT for rail-to-rail headroom.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ================= bias generation =================
* iref sinks the external 20 uA reference into a regular-NMOS diode.
Xbnd  iref iref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=2 w=8  nf=2
* regular mirror branches feeding PMOS diode references
Xbnm2 pbias_reg iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8  nf=2
Xbnm3 pbias_lvt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8  nf=2
Xbpd  pbias_reg pbias_reg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
* LVT NMOS diode: 20 uA from PMOS mirror + 10 uA from ncasc generator = 30 uA
Xbld  nbias_lvt nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12 nf=2
Xmpr0 nbias_lvt pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
* LVT PMOS diode: feeds 20 uA sink + 10 uA ncasc bleed + 10 uA pcasc_m bleed = 30 uA... (10 uA bleed to pcasc_m only)
Xbpld pbias_lvt pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
* startup pull resistors: prevent degenerate zero-current op solutions
Rst1 vdd nbias_lvt 5meg
Rst2 pbias_lvt vss 5meg
Rst3 pbias_reg vss 5meg
* ncasc = nbias_lvt + 0.2 V  (NMOS cascode gate bias)
Xmpr1 ncasc pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4
Rc1   ncasc nbias_lvt 25k
* pcasc_m = pbias_lvt - 0.2 V (PMOS cascode gate bias)
Xmnr1 pcasc_m iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
Rc2   pbias_lvt pcasc_m 40k
* pcasc = vdd - 2*Vsg_lvt (PMOS folder gate bias)
Xpcd1 pc1 pc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4
Rc4   pc1 pcasc 25k
Xmnpc pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
* pcasc_t = pbias_lvt - 0.1 V (PMOS tail cascode gate bias)
Xmnr3 pcasc_t iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
Rc3   pbias_lvt pcasc_t 10k

* ================= complementary input pairs =================
* NMOS LVT pair with source degeneration (Gm compression over PVT)
Xmn1 d1n vinn s1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmn2 d2n vinp s2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Rn1 ntail s1n 2k
Rn2 ntail s2n 2k
* PMOS LVT pair with source degeneration
Xmp1 d1p vinn s1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=12
Xmp2 d2p vinp s2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=12
Rp1 ptail s1p 2k
Rp2 ptail s2p 2k
* tails (20 uA each) with cascodes for CMRR
Xmn5  nt1 nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=4
Xmn5c ntail ncasc nt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=4
Xmp6  pt1 pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=16 nf=4
Xmp6c ptail pcasc_t pt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8

* ================= gm-control boosts (1:3, tail x4 when alone) =================
* P-boost: 60 uA into ptail when N-pair off (ntail low)
Xmp9  bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmn9s bp enp n9 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
Xmn9  n9 nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8
Xmp10 ptail bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
* ENp inverter powered from nbias_lvt (threshold tracks LVT vth)
Xmpi1 enp ntail nbias_lvt nbias_lvt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 nf=2
Xmni1 enp ntail vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=14 nf=4
* N-boost: 60 uA from ntail when P-pair off (ptail high)
Xmp9c n9p pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmp9s bn ennb n9p n9p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmn9d bn bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8
Xmn10 ntail bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
* ENnb inverter between vdd and pbias_lvt
Xmpi2 ennb ptail vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=6
Xmni2 ennb ptail pbias_lvt pbias_lvt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1

* ================= folded-cascode summing =================
* folding bias sources (50 uA)
Xmpb1 d1n pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmpb2 d2n pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmnb1 d1p nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmnb2 d2p nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
* PMOS folders: vinn side -> mirror input an; vinp side -> sum
Xmpf1 an  pcasc d1n d1n sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmpf2 sum pcasc d2n d2n sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
* NMOS low-voltage cascode current mirror (16 = 40 uA)
Xmnm1  c1n an vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xmnm1c an ncasc c1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xmnm2  c2n an vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xmnm2c sum ncasc c2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
* NMOS folders: vinn side -> mirror input bp2; vinp side -> sum
Xmnf1 bp2 ncasc d1p d1p sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmnf2 sum ncasc d2p d2p sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
* PMOS low-voltage cascode current mirror (80 = 40 uA)
Xpmm1  c1p bp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xpmm1c bp2 pcasc_m c1p c1p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xpmm2  c2p bp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8
Xpmm2c sum pcasc_m c2p c2p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=8

* ================= Class-AB output with Iq regulation =================
Xmnout vout sum vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=6
Xmpout vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=120 nf=24
* floating battery: Rb returned to buffered replica of sum (no sum loading)
* gp = sum - Vgs_bf + Vgs_d + (Iadj-11u)*Rb ; follower sink tracks Rb current
Xmnbuf vdd sum sum_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmnd nrb nrb gp gp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
Rb sum_b nrb 25k
Xmnbuf2 sum_b nrb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
Xmpadj adjn_c e radj radj sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Radj vdd radj 18k
Xmpadjc gp pcasc_m adjn_c adjn_c sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=4
Xmnex nex nbias_lvt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4
Xmnexc gp ncasc nex vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4
* quiescent current sense: N-side replica (1:10 of Xmnout)
Xmnr dsn sum vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3
Xmpsen  dsn dsn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmpsen2 dsn2 dsn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmnsen3 dsn2 dsn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
* sense sink and reference (6 uA)
Xmnsen4 e dsn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8 nf=2
Xmpref  e pbias_lvt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2.4
Ce e vss 1n

* ================= compensation =================
Rz vout cm 1.5k
Cc cm sum 15p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* SKY130 1.8V core models
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* === Bias ===
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* Cascode bias: stacked NMOS diode on top of iref → vcas ≈ 1.43V
XMN_CAS_BIAS vcas vcas iref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPREF pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNBIA pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
CBP1 iref vss 100p
CBP2 pbias vss 100p

* === Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + NMOS cascode mirror load ===
* PMOS tail: gate=iref, W/L=2
RSTART ntail vss 100MEG
XMP_TAIL ntail pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
* NMOS diff pair: W/L=16 (l=0.5, w=4, nf=2)
XMN1 nd1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMN2 nd2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
* NMOS cascode mirror:
* Bottom diode: nd1_bot = Vgs ≈ 0.87V at 10µA
XM3B nd1_bot nd1_bot vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* Bottom mirror: same current as diode
XM4B nd2_bot nd1_bot vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* Top cascode: gate=vcas (1.43V), source=nd1_bot (0.87V), drain=nd1
* Vgs = 1.43 - 0.87 = 0.56V > Vtn=0.4V ✓
XM3A nd1 vcas nd1_bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* Top cascode mirror: gate=vcas, source=nd2_bot, drain=nd2
XM4A nd2 vcas nd2_bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* === Stage 2: PMOS CS + NMOS current source ===
* PMOS CS: gate=nd2, W/L=8
XMP_CS out2 nd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
* NMOS load: gate=iref, W/L=2
XMN_CS out2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* === Output: push-pull ===
XMP_OUT vout out2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMN_OUT vout out2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1

* === Miller compensation ===
CMIL nd2 out2 15p
RMIL nd2 out2 2k

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier.
*
* Stages:
*  - 20 uA iref port diode + startup for a self-biased constant-gm core,
*    making input-pair gm (hence UGB) first-order flat over PVT.
*  - Complementary LVT NMOS/PMOS input pairs with tail-current boost
*    steering driven by vinp-referenced activity comparators
*    (thresholds 0.25*VDD and 0.85*VDD, outside the THD signal window).
*  - Folded-cascode current summing into the high-impedance node vg_n,
*    with cascoded mirror chains (m and n chains).
*  - Floating-diode class-AB level shift (XMNF) driving the LVT push-pull
*    output pair; series-RC Miller compensation CC/RZ.

.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- reference port + startup ----------------
XMN0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
XMNS pb_g iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=0.5

* ---------------- constant-gm bias core ----------------
XMNGA na na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10
XMNGB pb_g na cgr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40
RCG cgr vss 5.3k
XMPGA na pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=18
XMPGB pb_g pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=18

* ---------------- bias distribution ----------------
* nb_g: NMOS sink bias
XMNG nb_g nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
XMPG nb_g pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=18
* ncb: low-voltage NMOS cascode bias (~Vth + 0.75)
XMPCB ncb pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=18
RCN ncb nx 12.5k
XMNCB nx nx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.1
* pcb: PMOS cascode bias (~vdd - Vthp - 0.75)
XMNCB2 pcb nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
RCP px pcb 26k
XMPCB2 px px vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=32

* ---------------- input pairs, tails, boost ----------------
XMN1 s1 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=5
XMN2 s2 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=5
XMNTA tn nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10
XMNBS tn c_hi nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8
XMNBS2 nbs nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=24
XMP1 a1 vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=48
XMP2 a2 vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=48
XMPTA tp pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=45
XMPBS pbs c_lo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=40
XMPBS2 tp pb_g pbs vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=68

* ---------------- folded cascode summing ----------------
XMP3 s1 pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=152
XMP4 s2 pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=152
XMN3 a1 nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=47
XMN4 a2 nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=47
XMP5 m pcb s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=126
XMP6 vg_n pcb s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=126
XMN5 n ncb a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=31
XMN6 vg_n ncb a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=31

* m mirror chain (NMOS; diode bottom, cascoded output)
XMNMD m m vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=51
XMNMO mo_d m vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=51
XMNMOC vg_n ncb mo_d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=31
* n mirror chain (PMOS; diode bottom, cascoded output)
XMPND n n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=125
XMPNO no_d n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=125
XMPNOC vg_n pcb no_d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=125

* ---------------- class-AB output drive ----------------
* NMOS gate vg_n is the high-impedance summing node (DC set by outer loop).
* PMOS gate vg_p is replica-biased (XMPD sets Iq_p by ratio) and follows
* vg_n for AC through CAB; RAB provides the DC tie. No Vth-window hazard.
XMPD bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=20
XMND bp nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2.5
RAB vg_p bp 1e9
CAB vg_p vg_n 100p
XMNO vout vg_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=9
XMPO vout vg_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=3 w=96
RZ vout rzc 1.5k
CC rzc vg_n 17p

* ---------------- boost steering comparators ----------------
* reference divider: vref_hi = 0.85*vdd, vref_lo = 0.25*vdd
RA vdd vref_hi 180k
RB vref_hi vref_lo 720k
RC vref_lo vss 300k
* lo sensor: vinp < vref_lo -> c_lo low -> PMOS boost on (PMOS input pair)
XMPL1 dl1 vinp csl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10
XMPL2 dl2 vref_lo csl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10
XMPTL csl pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XMNL1 dl1 dl1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.25
XMNL2 c_lo dl1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.25
XMPLK c_lo pb_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=3
* hi sensor: vinp > vref_hi -> c_hi high -> NMOS boost on (NMOS input pair)
XMNL3 dh1 vinp csh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
XMNL4 dh2 vref_hi csh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4
XMNTH csh nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1.25
XMPH1 dh1 dh1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XMPH2 c_hi dh1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=6
XMNHK c_hi nb_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.63

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* Rail-to-rail input, high-gain folded cascode, Class-AB output stage
* Series-RC Miller compensation
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* =====================================================================
* BIAS NETWORK - generates all bias voltages from 20uA iref reference
* =====================================================================

* NMOS diode: absorbs 20uA reference, sets nbias gate voltage
XM_BN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* PMOS bias generation: NMOS mirror sinks 20uA into PMOS diode
XM_BP_M pbgen iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XM_BP_D pbgen pbgen vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* NMOS cascode bias (~0.985V): PMOS diode from VDD, NMOS sink
XM_NC_D ncas ncas vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM_NC_S ncas iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* PMOS cascode bias (~0.55V): NMOS diode from VSS, PMOS source
XM_PC_D pcas pcas vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XM_PC_S pcas pbgen vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* =====================================================================
* TAIL CASCODE BIAS - resistor divider
* =====================================================================
R_TN1 vdd ncas_tn 500k
R_TN2 ncas_tn pcas_tn 900k
R_TP2 pcas_tn vss 400k

* =====================================================================
* TAIL CURRENT SOURCES WITH CASCODE (40uA each)
* =====================================================================

* NMOS tail with cascode
XM_TN tailn_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM_TN_C tailn ncas_tn tailn_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* PMOS tail with cascode
XM_TP tailp_mid pbgen vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XM_TP_C tailp pcas_tn tailp_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* =====================================================================
* COMPLEMENTARY INPUT STAGE (LVT for rail-to-rail)
* =====================================================================

* NMOS differential pair (W/L=20)
XM_N1 nin_p vinp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
XM_N2 nin_n vinn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=5

* PMOS differential pair (W/L=60)
XM_P1 pip_p vinp tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
XM_P2 pip_n vinn tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=6

* =====================================================================
* FOLDED CASCODE - NMOS PAIR PATH
* =====================================================================

* PMOS current source loads (40uA each)
XM_PS1 nin_p pbgen vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XM_PS2 nin_n pbgen vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* PMOS cascodes (LVT)
XM_PC1 fc_o pcas nin_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XM_PC2 fc_o2 pcas nin_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* =====================================================================
* FOLDED CASCODE - PMOS PAIR PATH
* =====================================================================

* NMOS current source loads (40uA each)
XM_NS1 pip_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM_NS2 pip_n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* NMOS cascodes (LVT)
XM_NC1 fc_o ncas pip_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XM_NC2 fc_o2 ncas pip_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* =====================================================================
* OUTPUT STAGE - NMOS CS with PMOS active load, Miller compensated
* =====================================================================

* NMOS common-source amplifier (W/L=16, driven by first stage)
XM_ON vout fc_o vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4

* PMOS active load (biased from resistor divider)
* Resistor divider sets Vgp ~ 1.12V for proper output operating point
R_VGP1 vdd vgp 60.7k
R_VGP2 vgp vss 161k
XM_OP vout vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=4

* =====================================================================
* MILLER COMPENSATION (capacitor from cascode output to output)
* =====================================================================
CC1 fc_o vout 4p

* Termination capacitor for unused mirror-side cascode output
CT fc_o2 vss 0.5p

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail two-stage Miller-compensated operational amplifier

.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* === BIAS GENERATION ===
* NMOS reference diode: sinks 20uA, sets V(iref) ~ 0.88V
XMN_ref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2

* nbias: NMOS bias from PMOS current source + NMOS diode (~0.53V)
XMP_nbn nbias iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2
XMN_nbn nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2

* pbias: PMOS bias from PMOS diode + NMOS current sink (~0.33V)
XMP_pdb pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2
XMN_pdb pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2

* === NMOS DIFFERENTIAL INPUT STAGE ===
* Tail current source: uses nbias to set ~20uA tail current
XMN_tail tail_n nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2.0 nf=2
* NMOS diff pair (LVT for rail-to-rail)
XMN_d1 dn1 vinp tail_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
XMN_d2 dn2 vinn tail_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
* PMOS active load (current mirror)
XMP_m1 dn1 dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_m2 dn2 dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.0 nf=2

* === PMOS DIFFERENTIAL INPUT STAGE ===
* Tail current source: uses pbias to set ~20uA tail current
XMP_tail tail_p pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.0 nf=2
* PMOS diff pair (LVT for rail-to-rail)
XMP_d1 dp1 vinp tail_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
XMP_d2 dp2 vinn tail_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10.0 nf=2
* NMOS active load (current mirror)
XMN_m1 dp1 dp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.0 nf=2
XMN_m2 dp2 dp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.0 nf=2

* === SECOND STAGE (Common-source with Class-AB bias) ===
* Sum both stages at the second stage input
* PMOS drive: dn2 (output of NMOS stage)
* NMOS drive: dp2 (output of PMOS stage)

* Second stage PMOS: biased by dn2
XMP_s2 vout dn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40.0 nf=8
* Second stage NMOS: biased by dp2
XMN_s2 vout dp2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20.0 nf=4

* === MILLER COMPENSATION ===
* Compensation between first stage output and second stage output
Rc dn2 comp 5k
Cc comp vout 2p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB operational amplifier
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* IREF is a 20 uA DC current source from VDD into the iref pin (testbench).
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ========================= Bias network =========================
XBN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XNBIAS vbiasp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBP vbiasp vbiasp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate bias: resistor divider sets vcasn ~0.78 V.
RB1 vcasn vdd 100k
RB2 vcasn vss 75k

* PMOS cascode gate bias: diode + resistor + current sink -> VDD - (VGS + I*R).
XCP1 vcasp_d vcasp_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode Class-AB opamp, SKY130 1.8V.
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout   (iref sinks 20u from an external vdd-referenced source)
*
* Architecture:
*  - Complementary input pairs (NMOS + PMOS) with separate tails.
*  - Folded-cascode summing node x:
*      N path sources S_n = i_n2 + Iq1 - In/2 into x  (PMOS cascode)
*      P path sinks   K_p = i_p2 + Iq1 - Ip/2 from x   (NMOS cascode)
*    Tail-tracking mirror offsets keep S_n = K_p = Iq1 at balanced inputs for
*    every common mode, so the input-referred offset is CM-independent.
*    Differential polarity: vid+ pulls x down -> MOP sources -> vout up (non-inverting).
*  - Constant-gm tail steering: detectors watching (tp - tn) release a boost
*    device on the surviving pair when the other pair turns off.
*  - Class-AB output: PMOS CS gate=x, NMOS CS gate=xf (source follower of x).
*  - Series-RC Miller compensation from x.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias generation (sinks the 20u reference) ----------------
XMNB1 nb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMNB2 iref iref nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMNB3 pg1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMPB1 pg1 pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
* PMOS cascode bias for the N-fold: pc2 ~ vdd - 0.9
XMPB2 pc1 pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6.2 nf=16
XMPB3 pc2 pc2 pc1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=2
XMNB5 pc2 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
* NMOS cascode bias for the P-fold: ncab ~ 1.0
XMPB4 ncab pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMNC1 ncab ncab vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=2

* ---------------- input pairs and tails ----------------
XMTN tn nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=8
XMTNM mirn nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMPDN vdd mirn mirn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMTP tp pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMTPM mirp pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=5
XMNDP mirp mirp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.6 nf=6

XMN1 dn1 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4.1 nf=3
XMN2 dn2 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=4.1 nf=3
XMP1 dp1 vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=7 nf=5
XMP2 dp2 vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=7 nf=5

* ---------------- N fold: source S_n = i_n2 + Iq1 - In/2 into x ----------------
* dumped N drain dn2 carries i_n2; 1:1 sensed and mirrored
XMNS1 dn2 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.7 nf=16
XMNM1 un nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.7 nf=16
XMPU1 vdd un un vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMPMC1 wn un vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
* +Iq1 into wn
XMQ1P wn pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6.2 nf=16
* -In/2 from wn (tail-tracking)
XMPMT1 invn mirn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMNDI1 invn invn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMNI1 wn invn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
* PMOS cascode into x
XMC1P x pc2 wn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=8

* ---------------- P fold: sink K_p = i_p2 + Iq1 - Ip/2 from x ----------------
* dumped P drain dp2 carries i_p2; 1:1 sensed and mirrored
XMPS1 dp2 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.7 nf=16
XMNM2 up nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.7 nf=16
XMNDU1 up up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
XMNM3 wp up vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=4
* +Iq1 sink from wp
XMNQ1 wp nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5.4 nf=6
* -Ip/2 into wp (tail-tracking)
XMNMT1 tipp mirp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.6 nf=6
XMPPD1 vdd tipp tipp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
XMPMT2 wp tipp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.8 nf=10
* NMOS cascode from x
XMC2N x ncab wp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.5 nf=14

* ---------------- constant-gm tail steering ----------------
* (tp-tn) shrinks when either pair turns off; release the surviving pair's boost.
XCDN1 bon tp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=2
RD1 bon vdd 300k
XBN tn bon vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.1 nf=2
XCDP1 bop tn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=2
RD2 bop vss 300k
XBP tp bop vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=1.4 nf=2

* ---------------- class-AB output stage ----------------
XOP vout x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 nf=16
XFN xf x vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=4
XFT xf nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2.7 nf=2
XON vout xf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.5 nf=14

* ---------------- compensation ----------------
RZ x cz 2.2k
CC cz vout 12p
CFF x xf 0.7p

.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary rail-to-rail folded-cascode op-amp, SKY130 1.8 V core.
*
* Stage 1: complementary input pairs (NMOS nfet l=2, PMOS pfet_01v8_lvt l=2)
*          biased in moderate inversion from PTAT tail currents. Each pair is
*          folded into the single summing node "va" through opposite-polarity
*          cascodes; cascoded current mirrors subtract the two drain-current
*          sets so both differential signals add at "va".
*          A common-mode steering pair folds the PMOS tail current down as
*          the NMOS pair turns on, keeping total Gm nearly constant over the
*          whole input common-mode range.
* Stage 2: class-A output (PMOS driven from "va", NMOS at a fixed gate bias).
* Bias: all currents mirror from the 20 uA "iref" reference; input tails and
*       the steering tail run from a PTAT (Widlar) generator for a
*       temperature-stable transconductance.
* Compensation: series-RC Miller network from "va" to "vout".
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* --- master reference: iref = nfet diode drop at 20 uA ----------------------
XMb0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2

* --- pmir: lvt-pfet diode rail fed with 25 uA (pmir = vdd - |Vsg|) ----------
XFP25 pmir pmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=12
XFNK1 pmir iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2

* --- foldp: lvt-pfet diode rail fed with 30 uA; gate of the PMOS fold ------
XFPD foldp foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
XFNS foldp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=2

* --- foldn: nfet diode rail (~0.65 V); gate of the NMOS fold sinks ----------
XFF foldn foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XFD foldn foldn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3

* --- pcb: PMOS cascode gate (sets vx = vdd - 0.35) ---------------------------
RPC foldp pcb 24k
XSNC pcb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2

* --- ncb: NMOS cascode gate (sets vy ~ 0.4) ----------------------------------
XNCD ncd1 ncd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
XNCS ncd1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
RNCB ncd1 ncb 8.2k
XSNN ncb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2

* --- ncbm / pcbm: cascode gates for the summing mirrors ----------------------
XNMD nmd1 nmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XNMS nmd1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
RNMB nmd1 ncbm 18k
XSNM ncbm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
XPMD pmd1 pmd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2
XPMS pmd1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
RPMB pmd1 pcbm 10k
XSPM pcbm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2

* --- PTAT generator (Widlar): I ~ n*Vt*ln(8)/R; mirror rail "wdr" ------------
XMAF ga pmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=4
XMA ga ga vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMB wdr ga rw1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=160 nf=32
RWID rw1 vss 5.6k
XWP wdr wdr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=12 nf=2

* --- NMOS pair tail: smn diode carries a PTAT 25 uA --------------------------
XFPN smn wdr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25 nf=4
XDN smn smn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=37 nf=8
XMtn en smn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=37 nf=8

* --- steering pair: PMOS pair with a fixed 25 uA tail from foldp -------------
XMst st foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=75 nf=15
XMs1 sdmp vcm_d st vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
XMs2 sdmp2 vreflo st vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
XSDM sdmp sdmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XSDM2D sdmp2 sdmp2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* Level-shifted mirror of the steering current: sd2 = vdd - |Vsg|(Ip_set).
XSDP1 sd2 sd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=52 nf=11
XSDM2 sd2 sdmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RPU sd2 vdd 1meg
XMtp ep sd2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=52 nf=11

* --- input pairs ---------------------------------------------------------------
XMn1 vx1 vinn en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=70 nf=14
XMn2 vx2 vinp en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=70 nf=14
XMp1 vy1 vinn ep vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=88 nf=18
XMp2 vy2 vinp ep vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=88 nf=18

* --- fold sources/sinks with degeneration ---------------------------------------
XMfp1 rfp1 foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
RFP1 rfp1 vx1 1.5k
XMfp2 rfp2 foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=21 nf=4
RFP2 rfp2 vx2 1.5k
XMfn1 nf1d foldn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=6
RFN1 vy1 nf1d 1.5k
XMfn2 nf2d foldn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=6
RFN2 vy2 nf2d 1.5k

* --- fold cascodes -----------------------------------------------------------------
XMpc1 c1 pcb vx1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=32 nf=7
XMpc2 va pcb vx2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=32 nf=7
XMnc1 c3 ncb vy1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13 nf=3
XMnc2 va ncb vy2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13 nf=3

* --- NMOS-pair summing mirror (cascoded): sources i_d1 - i_d2 into va --------------
XN1d n1x c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62 nf=12
XN1dc c1 ncbm n1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XN1m n1mx c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=62 nf=12
XN1mc va ncbm n1mx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* --- PMOS-pair summing mirror (cascoded): sources i_p2 - i_p1 into va --------------
XP1d p1x c3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=20
XP1dc p1x pcbm c3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XP1m p1mx c3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=120 nf=20
XP1mc va pcbm p1mx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* --- input common-mode sense and steering reference ---------------------------------
RCA vinn vcm_d 100k
RCB vinp vcm_d 100k
XVRF vreflo foldp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=4
XVRL vreflo vreflo vrl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
RVRL vrl vss 30k

* --- second stage: class-A output -----------------------------------------------------
XOBP obp obp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=32 nf=7
XOBK obp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=2
XOBM obn obp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
XOBN obn obn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=3
XMoutp vout va vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=160 nf=23
XMoutn vout obn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=20

* --- series-RC Miller compensation -----------------------------------------------------
RZ va ncz 750
CC ncz vout 8p
.ends complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp

taskTitle: Design a complementary rail-to-rail Class-AB operational amplifier
circuit:
* Complementary folded-cascode Class-AB opamp, SKY130 1.8V core.
* Rail-to-rail constant-gm input (NMOS+PMOS pairs, PTAT tail bias with
* tail-current boost near the rails), folded-cascode summing node x,
* Miller R-C compensation, follower-driven class-AB output with a slow
* quiescent-current servo.
.subckt complementary_folded_cascode_ab_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*================ bias core =================
* iref sinks 20uA from vdd (external reference). NMOS master diode.
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* PTAT master, nominal ~1.5uA. dVgs of 1:8 weak-inversion pair across RPT.
XPTP1 ptc ptg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XPTP2 d2 ptg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XPTM1 ptg ptg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XPTM2 d2 ptg pt_r vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=480 nf=96
RPT pt_r vss 48k
RSTP iref ptg 2meg
* PTAT distribution buses: ptg (NMOS gate bus), npt_p (PMOS gate bus)
XMPTN npt_p ptg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XMPPD npt_p npt_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
* 20uA PMOS gate bus pb0 and 25uA bus pb25
XMNPB0 pb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMPPB0 pb0 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMNB25 pb25 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12.5 nf=2
XMPPB25 pb25 pb25 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=10
* 10uA fold bias diodes n10 / p10
XNF10SRC n10 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMNF10 n10 n10 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPF10SRC p10 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMPPF10 p10 p10 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
* bias voltage ladders (2uA each)
XMNLD lt1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XLT1 lt1 lt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XLT2 lt2 lt2 lt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XLT3 lt3 lt3 lt2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XLB1 lb1 lb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XLB2 lb2 lb2 lb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XLB3 lb3 lb3 lb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XPMLD lb3 pb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* ladder taps
RT1 lt1 tncbias 400k
RT2 tncbias lt2 600k
RPC1 lb1 pcas 300k
RPC2 pcas lb2 200k
RPC3 lb1 pcas2 200k
RPC4 pcas2 lb2 300k
* mid-rail anchor for node x
RVM1 vdd vmid 2meg
RVM2 vmid vss 2meg
CVM vmid vss 5p

*================ input pairs =================
XMN1 n1 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XMN2 n2 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XMP1 p1 vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24
XMP2 p2 vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24

*================ tails (PTAT 1.5uA) + boost =================
* NMOS tail, cascoded
XMTN tn_c ptg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XMTNC tn tncbias tn_c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
* NMOS tail boost twin + switch (on when PMOS pair is off)
XMTNB tn ptg bs_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
* PMOS tail, cascoded
XMTP tp_c npt_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XMTPC tp pcas tp_c vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
* PMOS tail boost twin + switch (on when NMOS pair is off)
XMTPB tp npt_p bs_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XSWP tp bstp bs_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
* NMOS-pair-off detector: flgn high when tn low; bstp = NOT(flgn)
XMNDN flgn tn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMNFL flgn pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XI1P bstp flgn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XI1N bstp flgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* PMOS-pair-off detector: tail sibling vs 1.5uA load; rsb high when off.
XMTPS rsp npt_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XMNRL rsp ptg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
RSKA rsp lt2 20meg
XI2P rsb rsp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XI2N rsb rsp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
* bstn drives the NMOS boost switch directly (bstn = rsb)
XSWN bs_n rsb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=6
CRSB rsb vss 0.5p
CBSTP bstp vss 0.5p

*================ folded branches =================
* fold current sources (10uA)
XPF1 n1 p10 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
XPF2 n2 p10 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4
XNF1 p1 n10 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
XNF2 p2 n10 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
* common-gate fold devices; right pair drives x directly
XMPC1 nsum pcas n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=20 nf=4
